Receive a boon from an evil creature that is equivalent in value to a month's service or an 8th-level spell without becoming indebted to the creature or giving up anything in return. This cannot be the result of magical compulsion.

Completion Benefit
You gain an amount of spell resistance equal to 5 + your character level against spells or spell-like abilities originating from outsiders.

Our Bounty, Our Glory.name: Our Bounty, Our Glory
Our Bounty, Our Glory.description:
You can ignore privation and channel your emotions to prepare for a later bounty.

Prerequisites
Be a member of House Denzarni, or have the Bloodthirsty, Omen, Tree Tender, or Unsuspecting Master background.

Benefits
You add 1 day to the time you can go without food or water before making Constitution checks and you add +4 to Constitution checks to stave off the effects of starvation and thirst.

Goal
You must succumb to your emotions and be victorious. Thwart an appropriate number of foes while you are subject to an effect with the emotion descriptor, such as rage.

Completion Benefit
Once per day, you can use heroes' feast as a spell-like ability with a caster level equal to your character level, although your feast does not grant the effects of neutralize poison or remove disease.

Out of the Sun.name: 烈阳眩目 Out of the Sun
Out of the Sun.description:
你和你的盟友利用太阳的光芒创造优势。

先决条件：唬骗3级，隐匿3级。

专长效果：当你的近战攻击命中时，你可以以一个移动动作进行一次使用虚招的唬骗检定。当该唬骗检定成功时，你不获得虚招效果，改由邻接你或邻接你的敌人，并同样持有此专长的盟友获得虚招效果，他对该敌人进行下一次攻击时敌人无法在AC上加上其敏捷加值（若有），这个攻击必须是在该盟友的下一轮或下一轮之前发动。当在强光环境中使用此专长时，你在唬骗检定上获得+2环境加值。在自然阳光下时，此加值提升至+4。你无法在昏暗或黑暗环境中使用此专长。

特殊说明：若你拥有精通虚招专长的话，你在近战攻击命中后，仅需要一个迅捷动作便能进行烈阳眩目专长的虚招。

书目：极限荒野UW／专长｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Outer Planes Traveler.name: 外域旅行者 Outer Planes Traveler
Outer Planes Traveler.description:
描述：你见识过多元宇宙的边缘地带，并从这些奇异的领域中获取了知识。你对其中某个特定领域有着特殊的亲和力，并在自身内携带着该位面的部分力量。

先决条件：知识（位面） 11 级，能够以法术或类法术能力施展 “异界传送” 或 “异界之门” 法术。

效果：从以下位面中选择一个。该位面的阵营必须与你的阵营相差不超过一个等级。你在对抗具有相关描述符的法术和类法术能力的豁免检定上获得+2加值，并且你施展具有该描述符的法术时施法者等级+1。

位面 阵营 描述符

天堂 守序善良 光亮

涅槃 中立善良 善良

极乐境 混乱善良 情绪

轴心境 守序中立 守序

骨园 中立 死亡

大漩涡 混乱中立 混乱

地狱 守序邪恶 痛苦

末日荒原 中立邪恶 邪恶

深渊 混乱邪恶 恐惧

新团队专长

本书第21页

以下这些团队专长是恶魔猎手们在多年对抗深渊恶魔势力的战斗中发展出来的。

协同干扰Coordinated Distraction

描述：当协同作战时，你能让敌人难以使用他们的魔法能力。

类型：战斗、团队

效果：当你和至少一名拥有此专长的盟友威胁到同一个敌人时，每有一个拥有此专长且正在威胁该敌人的角色，敌人在进行防御性施法时对抗的DC就+2。如果你或你的盟友因任何原因无法对目标进行借机攻击，便不能应用这个专长效果。

译者：阿什利天爪｜书目：恶魔猎人手册DHH／专长｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Outslug Sprint.name: 牙突·零 Outslug Sprint
Outslug Sprint.description:
你突入和位移的速度快如闪电。

先决条件：牙突式，牙突进，智力13，突刺（Lunge），寓守于攻或拳师武学智慧（Brawler`s Cunning）职业能力，对所选武器拥有武器专攻专长

专长效果：当开启牙突流架势时，你在进行五尺快步时可以额外移动5尺距离。

书目：专长／流派｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Outslug Style.name: 牙突式 Outslug Style
Outslug Style.description:
来源 武器大师手册Weapon Master's Handbook pg. 16

你如同疾风般突入或撤出战局。

先决条件：智力13，寓守于攻或拳师武学智慧（Brawler`s Cunning）职业能力，对所选武器拥有武器专攻专长

专长效果：选择一件贴身战士武器组中的武器，当你开启此流派架势时，如果你进行一次五尺快步，那么你就可以在防御等级上获得+1闪避加值，在所选的武器伤害上获得+1加值，持续到你的下一轮开始。

特殊情况：一个拥有拳师的殴斗大师或拥有武器训练（贴身武器）职业能力的角色可以使用任何贴身武器而非仅限于他所选的单件武器来获得此流派的好处。

书目：武器大师手册Weapon Master's Handbook pg. 16｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Outslug Weave.name: 牙突进 Outslug Weave
Outslug Weave.description:
来源 武器大师手册Weapon Master's Handbook pg. 16

你可以在远处对敌人的要害发动突击。

先决条件：牙突式，智力13，

书目：武器大师手册Weapon Master's Handbook pg. 16｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Overachiever.name: Overachiever
Overachiever.description:
Others made you feel small for too long, and now you drive yourself hard and never settle for second place.

Prerequisites
You must have been defeated by the same individual, organization, or creature type at least four times, or have the Boarding School or Humiliated background.

Benefits
You take only half the normal penalties from exhaustion. Choose one skill upon selecting this feat. Once per day, you can forgo rest to study or practice, gaining a +3 bonus on all checks attempted with your selected skill for 24 hours but becoming fatigued in the process. If you rest to recover from this fatigue, this bonus ends (but not if you recover from your fatigue in other ways, such as via lesser restoration). Forgoing rest for this purpose does not interfere with a spellcaster's ability to prepare spells.

Goal
You must utterly humiliate a member of your hated group by besting that creature at an activity for which it is known or in which it takes pride. This opponent's Hit Dice must exceed your current character level by at least 1.

Completion Benefit
Each time you forgo rest to study or practice, you can apply this feat's +3 bonus to a different skill. If you have 10 or more ranks in the skill selected, this bonus increases to +6.

Overhead Flip.name: Overhead Flip
Overhead Flip.description:
You hoist your opponent above your head before slamming him to the ground, temporarily staggering the foe.

Prerequisites
Str 13, Improved Grapple, Improved Unarmed Strike, Savage Slam, base attack bonus +9 or monk level 6th.

Benefits
While you are using Savage Slam, if you succeed at your grapple combat maneuver check to knock your opponent prone, the opponent must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + your base attack bonus) or be staggered for 1 round. Oozes, incorporeal creatures, and creatures that are immune to critical hits are immune to this effect.

Overpowering Stare.name: 威压注视 Overpowering Stare
Overpowering Stare.description:
Overpowering Stare（Stare）

你的痛苦注视足以压垮敌人心灵。

先决条件：催眠师11级，痛苦注视（painful stare）职业能力。

好处：当你触发你的痛苦注视时，目标必须通过一次意志豁免（DC=10+1/2你的催眠师等级+你的魅力调整值）否则困惑（confused）一轮。无论豁免是否成功，生物在24小时内不会再次受此能力影响。

催眠师诡计（Mesmerist Tricks）

下列催眠师诡计可由催眠师在通常学会催眠师诡计时选取。

精神印象（Psychic Impression）：物品保存着与之接触之人的精神印象，而足够强大的心智则能够阅读这些印象。当受术者触摸一个智力值至少为3的生物在过去10分钟内接触过的物品时，催眠师可以触发这项诡计。催眠师得知最后接触该物品生物的情绪状态的精神印象。该精神印象不包含图像或语言，若催眠师不认识这个生物，催眠师无法得知该生物是谁。

心灵链接（Telepathic Link）：受术者能够在危机之中向催眠师传递精神感应。当受术者与其盟友在战斗中以寡击众（outnumbered）时，催眠师可以触发这项诡计。受术者可以与催眠师进行心灵沟通，持续每催眠师等级1分钟。若受术者与催眠师间的距离超过中等距离（100尺+每等级10尺），心灵沟通连接就会被切断。受术者与催眠师须有相通的语言才能交流。

理性之声（Voice of Reason）：在催眠师的帮助下，受术者更易看破基于视觉的幻觉。当受术者尝试豁免检定来怀疑基于视觉的幻觉效果、而催眠师不受幻觉影响或不相信幻觉时，催眠师可以触发这项诡计。受术者在该豁免中获得等同于催眠师的魅力调整值的洞察加值。这项诡计不能用于不允许豁免的幻觉。

深邃注视（Bold Stares）

下列深邃注视可由催眠师在通常选择深邃注视时选取。

分神（Distracted）：催眠注视的惩罚也应用于专注检定（concentration checks）。

易感（Sensed）：催眠注视的惩罚也应用于隐蔽检定（Stealth checks）。

无助（Unaided）：催眠注视的目标无法提供或获得夹击修正（flanking bonuses）。

英雄地精专长

从伊斯格尔（Isger）的尖叫森林（Chitterwood）地下洞穴深处的钩爪部落（Hookback Tribe）到遥远的北伊利森（northern Irrisen）的霜皮（Frostfurs）部落，阿维斯坦各处都能寻见地精。虽然大部分地精生活在部落中，在破坏和与邻居的冲突茁壮成长，但仍有越来越多的地精离开家乡成为冒险者。虽然时常受到外界的猜忌，但地精仍可成为冒险团队中至关重要的一员。下列专长可供地精选取，允许他们善用广为人知的怪异为盟友提供帮助。

译者：晴澈之空｜书目：格拉里昂的英雄Heroes of Golarion／阿维斯坦与世界之冠｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Overseer of the House of Truth.name: Overseer of the House of Truth
Overseer of the House of Truth.description:
Your creator was a politician and administrator, and your memories are filled with the sound of clinking coins.

Prerequisites
Shabti.

Benefits
You gain a second daily use of your suggestion spell-like ability. You gain a third daily use at 8th level, a fourth at 13th level, and a fifth at 16th level.

Overwatch Style.name: 矢暴式 Overwatch Style
Overwatch Style.description:
你知道何时放开弓弦可以对敌人造成最大的伤害。

先决条件：快速射击，精准射击，对所选武器拥有武器专攻专长

专长效果：当你开启此流派的架势时，你可以以一个整轮动作，使用自己所选的武器准备两次远程攻击，每一次攻击都设定一个你所选的触发条件。你在这两次准备攻击的攻击检定上承受-2减值。

特殊情况：一个拥有武器训练（弓，弩或火器）职业能力的角色可以使用任何弓，弩或火器而非仅限于他所选的单件武器来获得此流派的好处。

书目：专长／流派｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Overwatch Tactician.name: 矢暴策 Overwatch Tactician
Overwatch Tactician.description:
你可以在短时间内预判敌人的行动并准备箭矢喂给他们。

先决条件：快速射击，精准射击，矢暴式，对所选武器拥有武器专攻专长

专长效果：当你开启矢暴流的架势时，你可以以一个标准动作而非整轮动作准备两次远程攻击。

书目：专长／流派｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Overwatch Vortex.name: 矢暴啸 Overwatch Vortex
Overwatch Vortex.description:
你箭壶里的每一支箭都知道自己的目的地在哪。

先决条件：快速射击，精准射击，矢暴式，矢暴策，对所选武器拥有武器专攻专长，基础攻击加值+11

专长效果：当你开启矢暴流的架势时，你可以以一个整轮动作，使用自己所选的武器准备最多四次次远程攻击，每一次攻击都设定一个你所选的触发条件。你在这四次准备攻击的攻击检定上承受-2减值。

书目：专长／流派｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Overwhelm.name: Overwhelm
Overwhelm.description:
You can overwhelm large foes with sheer numbers.

Benefits
You are considered to be flanking an opponent if at least one ally who also has this feat is threatening that opponent and the opponent is at least two size categories larger than the larger of you or your ally, regardless of your actual positioning.

Normal
You must be positioned opposite an ally to flank an opponent.

Overwhelming Phantom.name: 神威魅影 Overwhelming Phantom
Overwhelming Phantom.description:
出自《异能源始》（Occult Origins pg. 19）

你的魅影具有强大的意志，这使它能入侵并支配其他生物的思维。

先决条件：魅影职业能力，唤魂师15级

专长效果：每天3次，你在完全显形状态下的魅影能以一个标准动作尝试入侵并支配一个活物的思维；这样做会引发借机攻击。生物可以通过一个成功的意志豁免（DC=1/2魅影生命骰+魅影的魅力调整值）抵消这种影响。魅影能维持这种支配持续每个唤魂师等级1分钟，但是受支配者每分钟获得一次新的豁免对抗支配。这个能力如同高等占据术OA般运作。

灵魂共生（Overwhelming Phantom）

出自《异能源始》（Occult Origins pg. 19）

书目：异能源始OO／专长｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Owl Dive.name: 枭穿式 Owl Dive
Owl Dive.description:
来源 极限诡道Ultimate Intrigue pg. 88

武技训练让你能够在飞行和冲锋时穿过他人所处的空间。

先决条件：敏捷 17，枭冲式*（Owl Style），枭落式*（Owl Swoop），技能专攻：隐匿（Skill Focus：Stealth），BAB +7或武僧等级5级，特技动作1级，飞行1级，隐匿1级

专长效果：当你使用枭冲式（Owl Style）时，能够使用你的基本攻击加值取代你在飞行中投入的技能点数，并以此来判断你的飞行技能加值。你能够冲锋（charge）穿过其他生物占据的空间，但是和正常情况一样，你必须做出成功的特技动作检定才能通过敌人占据的空间。当你于冲锋途中穿过敌人占据的空间，而且在此时作出的特技动作检定中失败时，你的冲锋便会在进入该名敌人占据的空间时结束；如果你能威胁到该名敌人，则可以用你的冲锋攻击对抗该名敌人。

书目：极限诡道Ultimate Intrigue pg. 88｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Owl Style.name: 枭冲式 Owl Style
Owl Style.description:
来源 极限诡道Ultimate Intrigue pg. 88

你的攻击就像枭一般安静。

先决条件：敏捷 13，技能专攻：

书目：极限诡道Ultimate Intrigue pg. 88｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Owl Swoop.name: 枭落式 Owl Swoop
Owl Swoop.description:
来源 极限诡道Ultimate Intrigue pg. 88

武技训练让你能够以华丽的技巧移动。

先决条件：敏捷 15，枭冲式*（Owl Style），技能专攻：隐匿（Skill Focus：Stealth），特技动作1级，隐匿1级

专长效果：当你使用枭冲式（Owl Style）时，能够使用你的基本攻击加值取代你在特技动作中投入的技能点数，并以此来判断你的特技动作技能加值。你能尝试特技动作检定来在光滑或狭窄的表面上移动，也可以用于避免冲锋时引起的借机攻击，不过依旧如常承受全速进行移动所带来的检定DC提升和减值。

书目：极限诡道Ultimate Intrigue pg. 88｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Pacify Animal.name: Pacify Animal
Pacify Animal.description:
You are able to calm rampaging animals.

Prerequisites
Wild empathy class feature.

Benefits
As a full-round action, you attempt to mollify an animal or magical beast with an Intelligence score of 1 or 2 and an attitude of hostile toward you or your allies. You attempt a wild empathy check (DC = 10 + the target's Hit Dice + the target's Charisma modifier). If you succeed, the target's attitude toward you and your allies becomes indifferent for 1 minute, and it does not attack during this time. If the target is attacked during this time or if the target can see you or your allies after 1 minute, it becomes hostile again. A creature can be affected by this pacification attempt only once in a 24-hour period.

Special
Animal companions and creatures under magical compulsion are harder to pacify; the DC for such creatures equals 15 + the target's Hit Dice + the target's Charisma modifier. An animal companion also applies its bonus on Will saves from the devotion ability to this DC, and attacking the animal's master also breaks this effect. An animal companion's master can direct the animal to attack again, but the DC of this Handle Animal check is increased by your wild empathy modifier.

Pack Attack.name: 机动攻击 Pack Attack
Pack Attack.description:
专长类型：CombatTeamwork

你擅长绕着敌人转。

先决条件: 基本攻击加值+1。

专长效果: 当你发动近战攻击首次命中对手、且和拥有此专长的盟友邻接时，你可以通过直觉动作进行五尺快步，即便你这轮已经移动过位置。

通常状况: 你只能在没有移动过的状况下使用五尺快步。

资源出处: Ultimate Combat pg. 112

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Pack%20Attack

战策增益：当你邻接一个同样拥有这个专长的盟友时，你可以消耗2点耐力以一个自由动作而不是直觉动作来做出5尺快步。你仍然只能在一轮内使用一次这个专长的能力。

战策资源出处: Pathfinder Unchained pg. 128

Pack Flanking.name: 兽群围猎 Pack Flanking
Pack Flanking.description:
你和你的动物伙伴练习过如何围杀猎物。

先决条件：智力13，寓守于攻，可以获得动物伙伴

专长效果：当你和拥有此专长的动物伙伴共享方格或处于邻接状态，且同时威胁一个目标时，你们即都视为夹击目标，无论你们的位置如何。

正常情况：你必须和盟友处于目标的对角才能夹击目标。

译者：傻豆｜书目：专长／ACG 进阶职业手册｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Pack Intimidation.name: Pack Intimidation
Pack Intimidation.description:
You draw on the strength of numbers and your shared convictions to intimidate your foes.

Prerequisites
Half-orc, intimidating racial trait.

Benefits
Whenever you use the Intimidate skill to demoralize foes, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on your check for every ally who also has this feat within 30 feet (maximum +6).

Pack Rat.name: 老鼠搬家 Pack Rat
Pack Rat.description:
你总是带着各种各样意想不到的东西，今天丢了这个，明天就会翻出那个来。

先决条件: 鼠族。

专长效果: 每天一次，当你面临急需某一件普通物品的情况时，你可以在随身的收藏里马上找出它来。这件物品的价格不能高于25GP+5GP/你的每个等级，而且你需要为它“付钱”（你花钱买过它，只是大多数时候想不起来它在什么地方而已）。这件物品必须是某种易于你携带的道具——比如，如果你徒步行走并且只有一个背包，那么你不能掏出一口大铁锅。你不能使用该专长获得魔法物品，也不能获得某种特殊物品，比如某一扇门的钥匙。如果你脱光装备或者个人物品，那么你会失去该专长的好处，直至你再次拥有这些物品至少1天为止，来使你获得补给，用于“获取”新的物品。

资源出处: Monster Codex pg. 176

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Pack%20Rat

Pack Tactics.name: 群体战术 Pack Tactics
Pack Tactics.description:
你训练自己的动物伙伴，教会它们按你的指挥进行战斗

先决条件：智力13，动物伙伴职业能力

专长效果：在决定你和你的盟友是否会因为团队专长而获得加值的情况时，你的动物伙伴视为拥有对应的团队专长，但除非它确实选取了这个团队专长，否则动物伙伴自身无法从中受益。你和没有以及动物伙伴必须满足团队专长所描述的情况（如站位要求）才能获得团队专长的好处。

译者：傻豆｜书目：专长／进化职业起源（ACO）｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Page.name: Page
Page.description:
You recruit a page who heralds your approach and has the ability to smooth the path of your diplomatic missions.

Prerequisites
Character level 4th, proficiency with martial weapons.

Benefits
This feat is similar to the Leadership feat, with several exceptions. You can attract only a 1st-level cohort (referred to hereafter as a page) with this feat, and can't recruit followers. You determine your Leadership score according to the rules presented in the Leadership feat, but your page is always at least 3 levels lower than your level.

A page can take levels in bard, cavalier, or paladin. She cannot multiclass, though she can take any archetype for which she qualifies.

Whenever a page tries to influence a creature's attitude by using the Diplomacy skill, she can use her total Diplomacy skill bonus or yours. Any improvement of a creature's attitude toward the page also applies to you.

If a page gains enough XP to bring her to 2 levels lower than your level, she doesn't gain the new level until you gain your next level; until then, her XP total remains 1 less than the amount needed to attain the next level and she gains no additional XP until you advance in level.

If you release your page from service or otherwise lose your page, you can recruit a new one. At 7th level, you can swap this feat for the Leadership feat.

Painful Anchor.name: 痛苦之锚 Painful Anchor
Painful Anchor.description:
邪恶的异界生物在试图连接其他位面的时候将受到伤害。

先决条件：【锚定灵氲】职业特性。3

专长效果：当一个邪恶异界生物在你的锚定灵氲范围内使用呼唤、召唤、传送效果或者其他任何从物理上将生物于他位面间转移的（如‘闪现术’、‘幻化灵体’）能力时，它受到“4d8+你的魅力修正”的伤害。这是一种源自神圣力量的伤害，伤害抗力、免疫能量伤害、能量抗力对此不起作用。

译者：他化自在天｜书目：专长／UM 极限魔法｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Painful Blow.name: 苦痛一击 Painful Blow
Painful Blow.description:
你已经学会了如何让打击变得如此痛苦，以至于被击中的施法者很难集中注意力。

先决条件：

书目：秘术选集Arcane Anthology／专长｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Painful Cures.name: Painful Cures
Painful Cures.description:
Your healing spells exacerbate rather than alleviate pain.

Prerequisites
Evil alignment.

Benefits
Whenever you use a spell to restore hit points to a living creature, you can cause that creature to be wracked with waves of searing pain. If you do, the spell gains the evil and pain (Pathfinder RPG Ultimate Magic 251) descriptors. The target takes nonlethal damage equal to the number of hit points restored. If the target fails its saving throw or chooses not to attempt one against your healing spell, it takes a -2 penalty on saving throws and skill checks for 10 minutes per caster level. If the spell does not normally allow a saving throw, it instead allows a Fortitude saving throw to negate this penalty (but not the nonlethal damage dealt).

Paired Opportunists.name: 双重借机 Paired Opportunists
Paired Opportunists.description:
你明白如何让敌人为了懈怠的防守而付出代价。

专长效果：每当你邻近一名拥有该专长的盟友，那么在对抗同时处于你们威胁范围内的生物时，你们的借机攻击都会获得+4环境加值。若敌人处于你的威胁范围，那么只要他引起你的盟友的借机攻击，就也会引起你的借机攻击（即使由于某些能力或者环境，导致正常情况下不会引起你的借机攻击）。在对抗一名生物的一次特定动作时，该专长不会允许你获得超过一次的借机攻击机会。

译者：佐鸟カナコ，四月｜书目：专长／APG 进阶玩家手册｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Pantheistic Blessing.name: Pantheistic Blessing
Pantheistic Blessing.description:
You are grated a small bit of divine power as a result of your veneration of a pantheon of deities.

Prerequisites
Wis 13, must worship a pantheon of deities.

Benefits
When taking this feat, select a pantheon from the list below. You gain the listed spell-like ability for your selected pantheon, usable once per day. If the granted spell allows a saving throw, the DC is equal to 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Charisma modifier.

Special
If you act out of line with the tenets of your pantheons beliefs, you lose the ability to cast the granted spell-like ability until you have received an atonement for your transgression (as a cleric restoring lost class abilities).

Pantheons of Golarion

Each pantheon below notes the type of pantheon, as well as the member deities and the most common sorts of worshipers found within the faith. Additionally, each pantheon grants a spell-like ability to followers who take the Pantheistic Blessing feat. An asterisk after a deity’s name indicates that he or she is the head of the pantheon.

Archdevils (aligned, racial, and cultural)

Deities Asmodeus* (LE), Baalzebul (LE), Barbatos (LE), Belial (LE), Dispater (LE), Geryon (LE), Mammon (LE), Mephistopheles (LE), Moloch (LE)

Common Believers Chelaxians, devils, diabolists, tieflings

Granted Spell-Like Ability infernal healingISWG

Ascended Pantheon (cultural)

Deities Cayden Cailean (CG), Iomedae (LG), Norgorber (NE), Aroden (prior to his death), sometimes Irori (LN) and Nethys (N)

Common Believers Absalomians, adventurers, individualists

Granted Spell-Like Ability divine favor

Demon Lords (aligned, cultural, and racial)

Deities Abraxas (CE), Baphomet (CE), Cyth-V’sug (CE), Deskari (CE), Flauros (CE), Lamashtu* (CE), Nocticula (CE), Pazuzu (CE), Shax (CE), Sifkesh (CE), Zura (CE), many others

Common Believers drow, murderers, psychopaths

Granted Spell-Like Ability lesser confusion

Dwarven Pantheon (racial)

Deities Angradd (LG), Bolka (NG), Dranngvit (LN), Folgrit (LG), Grundinnar (LG), Kols (LN), Magrim (LN), Torag* (LG), Trudd (NG)

Common Believers dwarves

Granted Spell-Like Ability crafter’s fortuneAPG

Eldest (cultural and racial)

Deities Count Ranalc (CN), Green Mother (NE), Imbrex (LN), Lantern King (CN), Lost Prince (N), Magdh (LN), Ng (N), Ragadahn (CE), Shyka (N)

Common Believers druids, gnomes, fey

Granted Spell-Like Ability silent image

Elven Pantheon (racial)

Deities Calistria* (CN), Desna (CG), Findeladlara (CG), Ketephys (CG), Nethys (N), Yuelral (NG)

Common Believers elves, half-elves

Granted Spell-Like Ability identify

Empyreal Lords (aligned and cultural)

Deities Andoletta (LG), Arshea (NG), Korada (NG), Ragathiel (LG), Sinashakti (CG), Valani (CG), many others

Common Believers aasimars, angels, Kellids, Varisians.

Granted Spell-Like Ability protection from evil

Order of the God Claw Pantheon (aligned)

Deities Abadar (LN), Asmodeus (LE), Iomedae (LG), Irori (LN), Torag (LG)

Common Believers Hellknights

Granted Spell-Like Ability protection from chaos

Sandpoint Pantheon (cultural)

Deities Abadar (LN), Desna (CG), Erastil (LG), Gozreh (N), Sarenrae (NG), Shelyn (NG)

Common Believers natives of the Lost Coast

Granted Spell-Like Ability sanctuary

Taldan Pantheon (cultural)

Deities Abadar (LN), Cayden Cailean (CG), Norgorber (NE), Shelyn (NG)

Common Believers Taldan nationalists

Granted Spell-Like Ability shield of faith

Vudrani Pantheon (cultural)

Deities Chamidu (N), Dhalavei (LE), Gruhastha (LG), Irori* (LN), Lahkgya (CE), Likha (N), Ragdya (N), Raumya (NE), Suyuddha (LN), Vineshvakhi (LN), Vritra (LE), thousands of other deities

Common Believers Vudrani

Granted Spell-Like Ability true strike

Panther Claw.name: 豹爪 Panther Claw
Panther Claw.description:
来源 极限战斗Ultimate Combat pg.112

你在移动中以眼花缭乱之势反击攻向你的敌人。

先决条件：感知15，战斗反射，精通徒手打击，豹拳流

专长效果：你使用豹拳流时，你可以用自由动作进行对借机攻击的反击。你在你的行动轮中可以做出等同你感知修正次数的反击。

书目：极限战斗Ultimate Combat pg.112｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Panther Parry.name: 迅豹闪 Panther Parry
Panther Parry.description:
专长类型：Combat

你的猛恶攻击削弱了敌人趁你移动时袭击的能力。

先决条件: 感知15，战斗反射，精通徒手打击，豹形拳，豹爪。

专长效果: 你处于豹拳流派架势时，你的反击可以在对方进行借机攻击前作出，如果你的这次反击对对手造成伤害，对手对你的借机攻击在攻击骰和伤害骰都有-2罚值。

资源出处: Ultimate Combat pg. 112

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Panther%20Parry

战策增益：当你的反击对敌人造成伤害时，你可以消耗5点耐力来让目标在攻击和伤害骰上的减值提升到-4。

战策资源出处: Pathfinder Unchained pg. 128

Panther Style.name: 豹形拳 Panther Style
Panther Style.description:
专长类型：CombatStyle

你可以反击那些趁你移步而进犯的敌人。

先决条件: 感知13，战斗反射，精通徒手打击。

专长效果: 当你处于豹拳流派架势时，当你在穿过威胁区域而引发借机攻击时，你能以迅捷动作用徒手反击你的对手。这次攻击在诱发对方借机攻击后才能发动。

资源出处: Ultimate Combat pg. 112

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Panther%20Style

战策增益：当你引发借机攻击时，你可以消耗5点耐力来以迅捷动作做出一次反击。

战策资源出处: Pathfinder Unchained pg. 128

Pao-Lung Self-Improvement.name: 包陇自我修行 Pao-Lung Self-Improvement
Pao-Lung Self-Improvement.description:
作为包陇哲学的奉行者，你不断从错误中学习，缓慢却坚定地改进自身每一个方面。

先决条件：必须信奉包陇哲学，并且不得信仰任何神祇。

专长效果：每当你在属性检定、施法者等级检定、豁免检定或技能检定中投出自然1，或在这些检定中失败5点或以上时，你可以选择专注于这一种类型的检定（例如意志豁免或游泳技能检定）。在接下来的24小时内，你在此类检定上获得+1加值；每当你再次在此类检定中失败时，该加值提升1。若你在此类检定中成功，则该加值立即结束。一旦你指定了一个检定类型作为此专长影响的目标，在接下来的24小时内，你不得将该专长用于其他检定类型。

书目：古国血脉BotA／专长｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Paralyzing Strike.name: 定身拳 Paralyzing Strike
Paralyzing Strike.description:
你巧妙的一击命中对手的秘孔，使他全身僵直。

先决条件： 敏捷13，感知13，精通徒手击打，基础攻击加值+14

专长效果： 你必须在投掷攻击骰之前宣告使用此专长（因此，未命中会导致尝试失败）。定身拳在正常造成伤害的同时，还会强制受到你徒手击打伤害的敌人进行一次DC=10+1/2你的角色等级+感知调整值的强韧豁免检定。豁免检定失败的防御者将麻痹1轮或直到受到任何造成生命值伤害的法术为止。每4级你每天可以多尝试一次取力攻击，每轮不能超过1次。构装、泥怪、植物、不死、虚体生物和免疫重击的生物不会被本能力影响。

译者：傻豆｜书目：专长／ACG 进阶职业手册｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Parry Spell.name: 回击法术 Parry Spell
Parry Spell.description:
你能够将敌人的法术反射回它的施法者。

先决条件：法术辨识15级，精通法术反制。

专长效果：当你成功反制法术时，它会被反转至其施法者处。该专长与‘法术反转（spell turning）’法术完全一致。

译者：佐鸟カナコ，四月｜书目：专长／APG 进阶玩家手册｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Parting Blast.name: 临终念爆 Parting Blast
Parting Blast.description:
Parting Blast

你的死亡会引发一场临终爆破秀。

先决条件：念袭（Kinetic Blast）职业能力

好处：你能够承受1点超载，来准备一次在你死亡时自动触发的念袭。在你的超载被移除之前的任意时点，如果你被杀死的话，身体会立即释放出一场爆炸，这会对半径5尺范围内的所有生物造成伤害，伤害数值相当于你的简易念袭（Simple Blast）。临终念爆也会毁坏你的尸体，因此这可能会防止某些需要完整尸体的魔法产生作用。

译者：四月｜书目：专长／OA异能冒险｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Parting Shot.name: 牵制射击 Parting Shot
Parting Shot.description:
你是散兵中的能手，无论是在前进还是撤退中都可以将箭雨洒向敌人。

先决条件：敏捷13，闪避，灵活移动，近距射击，移动射击，基本攻击加值+6。

专长效果：每次遭遇1次，当你使用撤退动作时，你能够在移动中的任意一点进行单次远程攻击。

通常状况：你无法在撤退动作中进行攻击。

特殊说明：从6级起，选择【箭术战斗流派】的游侠能够将“牵制射击”作为战斗流派专长进行选取。

译者：佐鸟カナコ，四月｜书目：专长／APG 进阶玩家手册｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Partner.name: Partner
Partner.description:
The closest relationship one can achieve with an established merchant house is to be named a partner.

Prerequisites
Character level 9th. The character must have been a colleague of the merchant house for at least 3 years, and must have performed a life-changing service for a member of the house, such as saving her life or setting up a lucrative trade network in an otherwise inaccessible area (such as another plane).

Benefits
The character is offered adoption into the merchant family and citizenship in the empire of Kelesh, if she is not already a citizen. The character draws a stipend of 1,000 gp per month (funded by the house), can borrow up to 50,000 gp per year at no interest (the amount must be paid back within 1 year), and receives the non-monetary benefits detailed at the colleague level. Upon the character's elevation to the status of partner, the house gifts her with a custom magic item worth no more than 12,000 gp.

Pass For Human.name: 人类之证 Pass For Human
Pass For Human.description:
你很容易被误认为是人类，而非你的同族。

先决条件：半精灵，半兽人或者半身人（见特殊说明）。

译者：佐鸟カナコ，四月｜书目：专长／APG 进阶玩家手册｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Passing Grace.name: Passing Grace
Passing Grace.description:
Your bond with your allies allows you to share positive energy between yourselves.

Benefits
Whenever a healing spell or an effect would restore you to above your maximum hit points, you can redirect excess hit points to an adjacent ally who has this feat. This ability functions only for effects that require an action to activate--fast healing, regeneration, and other passive effects that restore hit points are not shared.

Passing Trick.name: 越位虚招 Passing Trick
Passing Trick.description:
专长类型：Combat

穿越一个敌人所在位置能给予你晃点他的机会。

先决条件: 智力13，寓守于攻，闪避，精通虚招，灵活移动，小体型或更小。

专长效果: 每当你成功的进行了一次特技检定以穿过对手所在空间，你可以用迅捷动作对其进行一次唬骗检定以施放虚招。

特殊说明: 如果你拥有“钻胯而过（Underfoot, APG）”专长而对手正好比你体型大，你在本专长的唬骗检定上获得+2加值。

资源出处: Ultimate Combat pg. 112

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Passing%20Trick

战策增益：你可以消耗5点耐力来在使用这个专长时以一个自由动作而不是迅捷动作尝试虚招。

战策资源出处: Pathfinder Unchained pg. 128

Pathfinder Society Ally.name: Pathfinder Society Ally
Pathfinder Society Ally.description:
The Pathfinder Society grants you access to its archives in thanks for services previously rendered.

Prerequisites
Associate (Pathfinder Society).

Benefits
The Pathfinder Society's vast archives are available for you to exploit. In any settlement that is the size of a small town or larger, you can spend 1d4 hours researching notes from available Pathfinders to gain a +4 circumstance bonus on a single Knowledge check.

Pathologist.name: Pathologist
Pathologist.description:
You can offer greater care for diseases and poisons than other healers can.

Prerequisites
Incredible Healer.

Benefits
When you use the Heal skill to treat disease or poison, instead of granting a +4 competence bonus on the target's saving throws to resist the affliction, you may instead choose to allow the target to use the result of your Heal check in place of his next saving throw to resist the disease or poison.

Patient Strike.name: Patient Strike
Patient Strike.description:
Your training under the Master of Swords has taught you that a well-timed strike is worth waiting for and that patience will serve you well in the long run.

Prerequisites
Int 13.

Benefits
You can choose to ready an attack as a fullround action instead of a standard action. When you do so, you gain a +2 bonus on your attack roll when your readied action triggers.

Normal
Readying an attack is a standard action and doesn't grant a bonus on your attack roll.

Pattern Message.name: 图纹讯息 Pattern Message
Pattern Message.description:
你已熟练掌握将秘密信息嵌入心灵幻觉的技巧。

先决条件：施法者等级 3 级

效果：当你施放"心灵幻觉"子学派的法术时，你可以在效果中嵌入一条简短的信息。你可以指定任意数量的法术目标来接收这条加密信息，不受语言限制，但只有未通过该心灵幻觉法术的豁免检定的生物才能接收到你的信息。这条信息以视觉形式传递，不包含其他生物可能偷听到的言语成分。在你专注维持心灵幻觉法术的每一轮中，你可以更改嵌入的信息以及接收信息的目标。

译者：佚名｜书目：遥远国度DR／专长｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Peace of Mind.name: 神清气正 Peace of Mind
Peace of Mind.description:
只需一念，你便能感受到涅槃境的安乐祥和

先决条件：知识（位面）3级

效果：以一个直觉动作，当你面对情绪(UM)、恐惧或痛苦(UM)的影响效果检定失败时，你可以忽略原效果的影响，改为你在原效果持续时间的双倍时间里处于晕眩状态。你因为原效果所受到的任何非致命伤害都会降低至最小（所有伤害骰子都取1）。你不能在晕眩时使用本专长。你每天能使用一次本专长，此外你在知识（位面）上的每5个等级都会使你每可用专长次数加一。

书目：专长／汲引专长｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Peacemaker.name: Peacemaker
Peacemaker.description:
Your words of peace ring true and are much more difficult for others to resist.

Prerequisites
Charisma 13, good alignment.

Benefits
The DC to resist spells you cast to ensure peace or force aggressive creatures to become peaceful increases by +2. This affects spells that dissuade creatures from aggressive actions without exerting long-term or absolute control over them, and without leaving them defenseless. These spells include, but are not limited to, calm animals, calm emotions, command, compassionate ally, enthrall, euphoric tranquility, sanctuary, and serenity.

Peerless Courtier.name: 楷模臣子 Peerless Courtier
Peerless Courtier.description:
作为一名深受总督喜爱的英雄，你已学会如何将战斗技巧转化为社会影响。

先决条件: 13魅力，BAB+3。

专长效果: 选择一个技能：唬骗，交涉或察言观色。你可以用你的基本攻击加值代替在选择技能等级。该技能也成为你的本职技能。

特殊说明: 你可以选择这一专长至多三次。其效果不叠加。每一次你选择这一专长，必须选择一个额外的技能。

资源出处: Heroes of the High Court pg. 17

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Peerless%20Courtier

Penetrating Possession.name: Penetrating Possession
Penetrating Possession.description:
Your ability to possess foes can bypass magical protections.

Prerequisites
Magic jar as a known spell or spell-like ability, Cha 21

Benefits
The first time you attempt to possess a host under the effect of protection from evil spell or any similar spell, you have a chance to dispel that spell as if you had cast dispel magic on the spell.

Penetrating Stare.name: Penetrating Stare
Penetrating Stare.description:
Your stare penetrates right through your foe's strongest mental defenses.

Prerequisites
Mesmerist level 7th, painful stare class feature.

Benefits
When you trigger your painful stare, the damage dealt ignores 5 points of the target's damage reduction, unless that damage reduction is untyped (for example, DR 10/--).

Penetrating Strike (Mythic).name: 穿透打击(神话) Penetrating Strike (Mythic)
Penetrating Strike (Mythic).description:
先决条件：穿透打击

你明白如何击穿身着重铠的敌人的守备。

神话专长效果：当你使用穿透打击专长或者高等穿透打击专长时，你能够增加这些攻击所无视的伤害减免的数值，你每拥有3个阶层，这个数值便会额外增加1点。此外，该效果还适用于无类别的伤害减免（比如DR 10/-）。

资源出处: Mythic Adventures pg. 70

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Penetrating%20Strike

Perfect Awareness.name: 完美警觉 Perfect Awareness
Perfect Awareness.description:
专长类型：CombatMeditation

你可以在短时间内拒绝所有不相干的感觉信息来获得对你周围环境的完美感知。

先决条件: 感知17，战斗冥想，冥想大师，角色等级9。

专长效果: 每天1次，你可以用一个移动动作在一次察觉检定中取20。

资源出处: Faiths and Philosophies pg. 19

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Perfect%20Awareness

Perfect Casting.name: 完美施法 Perfect Casting
Perfect Casting.description:
通过研究原初宝库的安全机制，你得以完美的防保护自己的神术施法

先决条件：战斗施法，神之严密，能够施放神术，信仰阿巴达尔

效果：当你使用神之严密专长时，你可以选择在施放所有的神术魔法时都不受到借机攻击，而非仅限无害和领域法术。

译者：傻豆｜书目：专长／内海诸神｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Perfect Center.name: 完美集中 Perfect Center
Perfect Center.description:
专长类型：CombatMeditation

你可以忽视几乎所有干扰

先决条件: 感知21，战斗冥想，冥想大师，角色等级17。

专长效果: 你可以在任何技能检定或者专注检定中取10，即使通常这个检定在紧张环境中不允许取10。

资源出处: Faiths and Philosophies pg. 19

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Perfect%20Center

Perfect Strike.name: 完美打击 Perfect Strike
Perfect Strike.description:
当你使用武僧武器时，攻击会变得异常精准。

先决条件：敏捷13，感知13，精通徒手打击，基本攻击加值+8。

专长效果：你必须在进行攻击检定之前声明使用该专长（因此失败的攻击检定会浪费这次机会）。你必须使用后述武器中的一种进行攻击：单镰，双节棍，木棍，十手以及破魔锥。你可以进行两次攻击检定并取较高的结果。如果这些检定中的一个造成重击威胁，那么另一个检定会被用于重击确认检定（如果两个检定均造成重击威胁，则由你进行选择）。每日你可以尝试进行“完美打击”的次数为每4级等级1次（见特殊说明），并且每轮只能进行1次。

特殊说明：

译者：佐鸟カナコ，四月｜书目：专长／APG 进阶玩家手册｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Perfect Style.name: 无瑕式 Perfect Style
Perfect Style.description:
Perfect Style (Combat, Style)

你已经接受了无瑕居流派的训练，并且与宗派相关的元素产生了一些联系。

先决条件：感知13，基本攻击加值+5或武僧等级5级

专长效果：当你选取该专长时，要从无瑕居流派（Houses of Perfection）中选取一种宗派；一旦做出这个选择，就无法再次变更。当你使用这个流派专长时，会根据你选择的无瑕居流派而获得一类能量抗力。难破金宗（Monastery of Untwisting Iron）的门生获得5点酸蚀抗力。无明火宗（Monastery of Unblinking Flame）的门生获得5点火焰抗力。不定风宗（Monastery of Unfolding Wind）的门生获得5点闪电抗力。若你已经从种族特性或者职业能力中获得了能量抗力，那么从这个流派专长中获得的能量抗力会与其叠加。

此外，你会获得丹田气池（ki pool），这些气是用来启动你所选择的无瑕居流派能力的。你在1级时气池里会有1点气，在1级之后的每4个等级这个气池会增加1点。若你由其他来源获得了丹田气池，则不会由于该专长而获得额外的气。

特殊情况：你可以多次选取本专长。每次你选择该专长的时候，都必须选择无瑕居流派中的另一个宗派。

译者：四月｜书目：专长／内海战斗｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Performance Weapon Mastery.name: 演武武器熟稔 Performance Weapon Mastery
Performance Weapon Mastery.description:
专长类型：Combat

你能手持任何武器进行华丽的表演。

专长效果: 你能将你擅长的任何类型的武器用于演武。

资源出处: Ultimate Combat pg. 112

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Performance%20Weapon%20Mastery

战策增益：只要你的耐力池中还有1点耐力，你就能将你的所有武器——不只是你擅长的——视为拥有演武UC武器特性。

战策资源出处: Pathfinder Unchained pg. 128

Performing Combatant.name: 演武战士 Performing Combatant
Performing Combatant.description:
专长类型：Combat

通过展现炫目而华丽的技巧，你能将任何战斗都打成一场表演。

先决条件: 炫目技巧，任一项演武专长。

专长效果: 你可以在任何战斗中进行演武检定。如果在一场非演武战斗中进行演武检定，你可以选择一项演武专长以供使用。你自动获得这项演武专长的所有加值；然后你需要进行一次DC20的演武检定，如果你成功，你可以获得该专长的所有效果。

资源出处: Ultimate Combat pg. 112

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Performing%20Combatant

战策增益：当你使用这个专长时，你可以消耗至多5点耐力来在你的演武战斗检定上获得等同于你消耗耐力的加值。

战策资源出处: Pathfinder Unchained pg. 128

Pernicious Stab.name: 致命毒刺 Pernicious Stab
Pernicious Stab.description:
描述：当对手无暇防守时，你凭借深入打击来施加毒药。

类型：战斗

先决条件：偷袭2d6。

效果：当你用淬毒武器击中敌人并且可以造成偷袭伤害时，你能选择放弃一部分或全部的偷袭伤害来增加毒药生效的可能性。每放弃2d6点偷袭伤害，你攻击所附带的毒素DC会+1。此毒素豁免DC的加值不适用于免疫精准伤害的生物。

译者：阿什利天爪｜书目：巨人猎手手册／专长｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Persistent Spell.name: 顽强法术 Persistent Spell
Persistent Spell.description:
你可以调整一个法术，使其更加难以被抵御。

专长效果：每当一名生物成为顽强法术的目标或者处于法术范围内，并且成功豁免该法术，那么他必须进行另一次豁免检定对抗法术效果。如果该名生物在第二次豁免中失败，那么他会受到法术的全部效果影响，就如同他在第一次豁免中失败一样。顽强法术占用比法术的实际环级高2环的法术位。不需要进行豁免来抵抗或减免效果的法术不会由该专长受益。

贴身射击（Point Blank Master）〔战斗〕

你擅长使用远程武器在极近的距离攻击。

先决条件：某种远程武器的武器专精。

专长效果：选择一类远程武器。当你使用这类武器在敌人的威胁范围内进行射击时不会引起借机攻击。

译者：佐鸟カナコ，四月｜书目：专长／APG 进阶玩家手册｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Personal Chronicler.name: Personal Chronicler
Personal Chronicler.description:
Psychopomps have sent a nosoi scribe to record your actions.

Prerequisites
Duskwalker.

Benefits
You gain a fledgling nosoi familiar as per the arcane bond class feature, using your character level as your wizard level. Treat this as either a raven or a whippoorwill familiar (a whippoorwill uses the statistics for a thrush, but grants a +3 bonus to Intimidate instead of Diplomacy). If you have the ability to gain a familiar through other means and you are at least 5th level, the bird is instead treated as a Improved Familiar feat. You can have only one familiar.

This feat can be taken a second time by a character of 7th level or higher if that character doesn't otherwise have access to a familiar. Such characters treat their familiars as nosoi, as described above.

Special
If you ever willingly consort with sahkils or undead, your familiar abandons you and reports your actions to the nearest psychopomps. To regain your familiar, you must atone for your deeds via the atonement spell.

Persuasive (Mythic).name: 谈判专家(神话) Persuasive (Mythic)
Persuasive (Mythic).description:
先决条件：谈判专家

舌灿莲花的你精通话术。

神话专长效果：谈判专家专长对交涉与威吓技能检定带来的加值增加2点。此外，你能够花费1次神话之力，使得1次交涉或者威吓检定就好像自然掷出20一般。你必须在进行检定之前决定使用该能力。

资源出处: Mythic Adventures pg. 70

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Persuasive

Persuasive Bribery.name: 行贿高手 Persuasive Bribery
Persuasive Bribery.description:
你知道如何用金钱打动他人。

先决条件: 谈判专家。

专长效果: 当你尝试以交涉检定贿赂某人（bribe someone）、以及用交涉或魅力检定与被呼唤的生物（比如异界盟友或异界誓缚法术呼唤的生物）讨价还价时获得+2加值，上述加值是在贿赂本身带来的任何加值之外额外提供的。当某人初次拒绝你提出的贿赂时，这个人对你的态度不会恶化，即便在正常情况下这种提议会冒犯到对方也是如此。

资源出处: Ultimate Intrigue pg. 88

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Persuasive%20Bribery

Persuasive Performer.name: 术艺知心 Persuasive Performer
Persuasive Performer.description:
对你来说，表演的艺术才是交涉的核心

先决条件：触类旁通职业能力，信仰莎琳

效果：你可以使用任何表演技能检定，而非仅限（表演[键盘，演讲，弦乐，吹奏]）来作为你的交涉检定结果。如果你使用表演（键盘，演讲，弦乐，吹奏）检定来取代交涉检定，那么你在检定上获得+2加值。

投毒引导 Posioner`s Channel

译者：傻豆｜书目：专长／内海诸神｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Perturbing Stare.name: Perturbing Stare
Perturbing Stare.description:
Your stare dulls your foe's reactions.

Prerequisites
Mesmerist level 5th, painful stare class feature.

Benefits
When you trigger your painful stare, the target must succeed at a Will save (DC = 10 + half your mesmerist level + your Charisma modifier) or lose its Dexterity modifier to AC for 1 round.

Pesh Euphoria.name: Pesh Euphoria
Pesh Euphoria.description:
The calming effects of pesh make you difficult to disturb.

Prerequisites
Sahir-Afiyun or pesh addict.

Benefits
When you take a dose of pesh, in addition to its normal initial effect, you gain a +2 bonus on saves against emotion and fear effects. Once per day, if you fail a saving throw against an emotion or fear effect while you are under the initial effect of pesh, you can attempt another saving throw 1 round later at the same DC.

Pesh Healing.name: Pesh Healing
Pesh Healing.description:
Consuming pesh makes you feel healthier.

Prerequisites
Sahir-Afiyun or pesh addict.

Benefits
When you take a dose of pesh, in addition to its normal initial effect, you gain a number of temporary hit points equal to your total Hit Dice for 1 hour. Temporary hit points gained from additional doses of pesh do not stack.

Pesh Rejuvenation.name: Pesh Rejuvenation
Pesh Rejuvenation.description:
When you are close to death, your body can convert pesh into lifesaving medicine.

Prerequisites
Sahir-Afiyun or pesh addict.

Benefits
If you are brought to 0 or fewer hit points while under the initial effect of pesh, you can end the drug's initial effect as an immediate action. If you do, you gain a number of temporary hit points equal to your Constitution score. These temporary hit points last 1 hour. Upon using this feat, you are sickened for 1d6 hours.

Pestilent.name: Pestilent
Pestilent.description:
Your unarmed strikes and natural weapons cause extra harm to those infected with your disease.

Prerequisites
Ability to cause disease via a spell, spell-like ability, or supernatural means.

Benefits
When you successfully use a spell, spell-like ability, or supernatural ability to cause a creature to contract a disease, you gain a +2 bonus on attack rolls with natural weapons and unarmed strikes against that creature. In addition, such attacks deal an additional 1d6 points of negative energy damage. If you have the supernatural ability to cause a single disease (such as mummy rot), you gain these bonuses against any creature that has contracted the same disease, even if it did not contract it from you.

Phalanx Formation.name: 集团方阵战术 Phalanx Formation
Phalanx Formation.description:
你接受过使用长武器在集团方阵内战斗的训练。

先决条件：BAB+1

专长效果：当你持用你擅长的长触及武器时，盟友不会在你进行长触及攻击时为敌人提供软掩蔽。

通常状况：攻击处于另一个生物后方的单位，包括盟友后方的单位时，目标会受到软掩蔽影响。

译者：月夜白雨｜书目：专长／近战战术工具箱｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Phantom Ally.name: 魅影盟友 Phantom Ally
Phantom Ally.description:
你拥有的力量与经验的每一点滴都会具象于跟随你的魅影之上。

先决条件：魅影职业能力

专长效果：你的魅影拥有的能力视为你在拥有魅影职业能力的职业等级上增加4级，最高不超过你的角色等级。

译者：犬良人｜书目：闹鬼英雄手册HHH／专长｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Phantom Fighter.name: 魅影战士 Phantom Fighter
Phantom Fighter.description:
Phantom Fighter

对于虚体敌人来说，你的魅影是致命的对手。

先决条件：魅影（Phantom）职业能力，魅影具有魔法攻击（Magic Attack）能力

好处：你的魅影（Phantom）的天生武器被视为具有幽冥（ghost touch）特性。此外，当你施放一个接触法术，并由你的魅影进行传递时，你能够如同自身具有

译者：四月｜书目：专长／OA异能冒险｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Phantom Fortification.name: 强固魅影 Phantom Fortification
Phantom Fortification.description:
Phantom Fortification

即便你的魅影完全显化为灵质态，它仍旧能在某种程度上具有无形的特质。

先决条件：魅影（Phantom）职业能力，魅影具有幽魂飞行（Incorporeal Flight）能力

好处：当你的魅影完全以灵质态显形时，它有50%的概率忽略重击以及基于精准的伤害，就如同佩戴了具有中等护命（moderate fortification）特殊能力的护甲一般。该能力不会与其他类似的效果叠加，而且在对抗幽冥武器（ghost touch）或力场构成的武器（比如金刚拳、法师之剑、或灵能武器法术）做出的攻击时不会生效。

译者：四月｜书目：专长／OA异能冒险｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Phase Strike.name: 相位打击 Phase Strike
Phase Strike.description:
专长类型：CombatConduit

你通过灵界位面打击，使你的武器穿透障碍、盔甲、甚至重重掩蔽来实现一击命中。

先决条件: 知识(位面) 10级。

专长效果: 以一个移动动作,你可以放逐手中的一把人造武器或一枚弹药到灵界,在你的回合结束前你用该武器所做的下一次近战攻击或远程投掷攻击视为接触攻击并无视掩蔽,但此攻击无法忽视由力场效果带来的AC加值.按这种攻击方式,此次攻击可以穿过全掩蔽进行,但你必须选定你攻击目标所在的方格.

你可以获得本专长的好处每天一次,在知识(位面)上每有10级额外增加一次.本专长在与灵界位面不相接的位面里无法生效.

资源出处: Planar Adventures pg. 31

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Phase%20Strike

Photosynthetic Healing.name: 光合治疗 Photosynthetic Healing
Photosynthetic Healing.description:
你可以利用阳光治愈自己。

先决条件：体质15，【变身】特性，藤蔓莱西

好处：你能够暂时地吸收太阳光用于治疗你的伤口。当你变身为植物形态时，只要你位于明亮的自然阳光光照环境下，你就可每日一次地用一个自由动作激活此能力以在接下来等同于你的HD数的轮数里获得1快速治疗。

译者：Shift_FK｜书目：其他种族／藤蔓莱西UW｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Piercing Chant.name: 刺耳歌唱 Piercing Chant
Piercing Chant.description:
Piercing Chant

音乐在地精文化中至关重要——至少，地精喜欢用尖锐刺耳的歌曲来描述它们如何杀死最后一个敌人或者他们晚餐烤了什么。不过，你已经知道非地精并不会喜欢你的歌喉。

先决条件：地精

好处：你可以以一个整轮动作吟唱恐怖又震耳欲聋的歌曲，每个在你15尺范围内能够听到它的敌人必须通过一个意志豁免检定（DC=10+你等级的一半+你的魅力调整值）否则晕眩（Dazed）一轮。无论豁免是否成功，该生物在24小时内不能再次成为该能力的目标。这是一个影响心灵效果。

译者：晴澈之空｜书目：格拉里昂的英雄Heroes of Golarion／阿维斯坦与世界之冠｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Piercing Gambit.name: Piercing Gambit
Piercing Gambit.description:
You cast a spell destined to fail in order to help your ally overcome an enemy's spell resistance.

Prerequisites
Spell Penetration or Bluff 3 ranks; caster level 1st.

Benefits
You can expend one prepared spell or spell slot, as if you had cast the spell, to weaken an enemy's defenses. Your spell has no effect, but a designated ally who also has this feat gains a bonus on her caster level check to overcome spell resistance equal to half the level of the spell or spell slot you expended, lasting until the start of your next turn.

Piercing Grapple.name: 刺击擒抱 Piercing Grapple
Piercing Grapple.description:
专长类型：Combat

你能用一把短小却又致命的武器制服敌人，迫使他在投降与痛苦中作出选择。

先决条件: 敏捷 13，精通擒抱，精通徒手打击，即时备战，威吓7级。

专长效果: 当你发起擒抱（initiate a grapple）时，能够拔出1把轻型或单手穿刺武器（light or one-handed piercing weapon）并把它刺向你要擒抱的敌人。当你如此发起擒抱时，会在战技检定上承受-2减值，但因为你是以发起擒抱的一部分拔出武器，所以不会因为手持这把武器而承受通常的-4减值。若你的检定成功，则会如常擒抱敌人，而且在判断是否承受-4减值或者在维持擒抱中造成伤害时，这把武器不被视为在你的手中。若你的敌人成功打破了擒抱，它便会受到伤害，数值为你使用的那把武器的基础武器伤害外加1d4点出血伤害（bleed damage）。成功通过DC 15的医疗检定或任何魔法医疗都能够结束出血效果（bleed damage）。若你主动结束擒抱，也可以选择不造成出血伤害，但是无论何种方式，你的敌人都会受到基础武器伤害。当你维持此类擒抱时，会在所有用于对抗你的敌人的威吓检定中获得+2环境加值。

资源出处: Ultimate Intrigue pg. 88

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Piercing%20Grapple

Piercing Spell.name: 法术穿刺 Piercing Spell
Piercing Spell.description:
你从研究之中得到了克服法术抗力的方法。

专长效果：当你释放一个穿刺超魔的法术用于克服目标的法术抗力时，将目标的法术抗力视为比正常情况下低5点。法术穿刺须占用高于原本1个环级的法术位。

译者：他化自在天｜书目：专长／UM 极限魔法｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Pile On.name: 自信粉碎 Pile On
Pile On.description:
专长类型：Combat

你可以通过打脸让对手惧栗不能自已。

先决条件: 力量13，痛殴，猛力攻击。

专长效果: 每轮一次，当你对一个已经处于颤栗，恐慌或惊惧的生物造成伤害时，你可以选择将这次伤害后降低一半，使你的目标额外受到一轮恐惧效果的影响。

资源出处: Monster Codex pg. 20

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Pile%20On

Pin Down.name: 压迫锚定 Pin Down
Pin Down.description:
专长类型：Combat

你可以轻松的阻止敌人逃跑。

先决条件: 战斗反射，战士等级11。

专长效果: 每当你威胁之下的对手进行五尺快步或使用撤退动作，他都将触发你的借机攻击。如果攻击命中，你不造成伤害，不过目标这次5尺快步或撤退动作将不能移动任何距离。

资源出处: Ultimate Combat pg. 113

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Pin%20Down

战策增益：当你使用这个专长时，你可以消耗5点耐力来在该借机攻击上既获得该专长的好处又能造成伤害。

战策资源出处: Pathfinder Unchained pg. 129

Pinch Time.name: Pinch Time
Pinch Time.description:
Often having one parent with a human lifespan and one with an elven lifespan, many half-elves have a skewed perception of time, and none more so than the Spireborn, who also study the subject of time academically.

Prerequisites
Character level 5th, Spireborn half-elf.

Benefits
Once per day, as a standard action, you can gain the benefits of haste until the end of your next turn.

Pinning Knockout.name: 压制击昏 Pinning Knockout
Pinning Knockout.description:
专长类型：Combat

你能轻松击倒一个被你压制的敌人。

先决条件: 敏捷13，高等擒抱，精通擒抱，精通徒手打击，基本攻击加值+9或武僧9级。

专长效果: 当你压制一个对手，如果你成功的进行了一次擒抱战技检定、并且对其用徒手打击或轻型/单手武器造成非致命伤害，你的伤害翻倍。任何免疫重击的生物也免疫该专长的影响。

资源出处: Ultimate Combat pg. 113

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Pinning%20Knockout

战策增益：当你使用徒手击打或者轻型或单手武器对一个被压制的敌人使用该专长造成非致命伤害时，你可以消耗5点耐力来将伤害提升到三倍而不是两倍。

战策资源出处: Pathfinder Unchained pg. 129

Pinning Rend.name: 撕裂压制 Pinning Rend
Pinning Rend.description:
专长类型：Combat

当你攻击你压制中的对手时你可以撕裂他的肌肉。

先决条件: 敏捷13，高等擒抱，精通擒抱，精通徒手打击，基本攻击加值+9或武僧9级。

专长效果: 当你压制一个对手，如果你成功的进行了一次擒抱战技检定、并且对其用徒手打击或轻型/单手武器造成伤害，该对手将会受到等同你的徒手或轻型/单手武器的流血伤害。任何免疫重击的生物也免疫该专长的影响。

资源出处: Ultimate Combat pg. 113

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Pinning%20Rend

战策增益：当你使用这个专长造成流血伤害时，你可以消耗至多5点耐力来让流血伤害提升等同于你消耗的耐力的点数。

战策资源出处: Pathfinder Unchained pg. 129

Pinpoint Jab.name: Pinpoint Jab
Pinpoint Jab.description:
You strikes land exactly where you mean them to.

Prerequisites
Improved Unarmed Strike, base attack bonus +6, ki pool or martial flexibility class feature.

Benefits
As a full-round action, you can expend 1 ki point or one daily use of martial flexibility to use a limited version of the targeted strike deed, targeting either hands or legs with an unarmed attack. A target who succeeds at a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + your base attack bonus) can negate the effect. When your base attack bonus reaches +11, you can instead target head or torso, which the target can negate with a Fortitude save. When your BAB reaches +16, you can target two locations; the target must save against each effect separately.

Special
A monk can substitute his class level for his base attack bonus for this feat's effects.

Pinpoint Poisoner.name: 毒针刺击 Pinpoint Poisoner
Pinpoint Poisoner.description:
专长类型：Combat

你熟练地使用特制的针管进行淬毒，使其能发挥最大的杀伤力。

先决条件: 虺蛇打击，双武器战斗或【疾风连击】职业特性，手艺（炼金）6级。

专长效果: 当你使用“虺蛇打击”专长时，你可以选择在两支吹箭（blowgun dart）上进行淬毒，并且用其对你的敌人进行近战攻击（取出吹箭是一个自由动作）。当你持有吹箭时，你可以使用一个标准动作用其中一支进行攻击，或用整轮动作使用两支同时攻击。这些攻击被视为近战接触攻击，造成1d2加上你的正常徒手打击伤害加值的伤害，并且将会传递毒药。你也可以选择像投掷手里剑一样投掷吹箭，这需要进行一次正常的远程攻击检定以对抗目标的AC。

通常状况: 在武器或弹药上淬毒是一个标准动作。

资源出处: Ultimate Combat pg. 113

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Pinpoint%20Poisoner

战策增益：当你在使用这个专长以投掷手里剑的方式向一个10尺内的目标投掷吹箭时，你可以消耗5点耐力来让这次攻击对抗目标的接触AC。

战策资源出处: Pathfinder Unchained pg. 129

Pinpoint Targeting (Mythic).name: 精确瞄准(神话) Pinpoint Targeting (Mythic)
Pinpoint Targeting (Mythic).description:
先决条件：精确瞄准

你的攻击能够直击敌人的弱点并且忽略多种防护。

神话专长效果：即便你在该轮移动过也可以使用本专长，不过这只限于你移动的距离不超过每阶层5尺的时候。

资源出处: Mythic Adventures pg. 70

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Pinpoint%20Targeting

Piranha Strike.name: 食人鱼打击 Piranha Strike
Piranha Strike.description:
你进行快速的组合打击，牺牲精确度，造成大量致命的小伤口。

先决条件：武器娴熟，基本攻击加质+1

专长效果：你使用轻武器时可以选择在命中和战技检定上承受-1的惩罚，使伤害增加2，此加值在你使用副手武器的时候减半，当你的基本攻击加值达到+4和之后每增加4点的时候命中减值上升1点，而伤害增加2点，你必须在攻击前使用此专长，且效果延续到你下一轮开始。此伤害加值不会在碰触攻击或不造成生命值伤害的攻击上生效，食人鱼打击无法和猛力攻击一起使用。

译者：PATIBAUL｜书目：专长／萨加瓦，失落的殖民地｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Plague Resistance.name: 疫抗 Plague Resistance
Plague Resistance.description:
疾病对你造成的影响往往较为轻微。

先决条件：体质13。

专长效果：当你因疾病而承受属性伤害或属性吸取时，分别对每个属性的伤害与吸取各掷两次并取较低结果。除此之外，你仍照常承受疾病的其他任何效果。

书目：反派法典VC／专长｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Plains Nomad.name: 莽原牧者 Plains Nomad
Plains Nomad.description:
你是那无垠的温带草原、热带草原、或高纬草原上的原住民。

先决条件：偏好地形（平原）职业能力。

专长效果：你和一匹你骑乘的坐骑，可在避免因急行（hustling）或强行军（forced march）所致伤害和疲乏（fatigue）的体质检定上，获得+2加值。在平原（plains）地形上时，此加值翻倍，且在避免迷路的生存检定、发现食物和饮水的生存检定、避免自己免受恶劣天气影响的生存检定、以及预测天气的生存检定上，该加值同样适用。

书目：极限荒野UW／专长｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Planar Focus.name: 位面之力 Planar Focus
Planar Focus.description:
通过学习其他位面，你学会了如同动物一样呈现位面的样貌。

先决条件: 知识（位面）5级，动物之力职业特性。

专长效果: 当你使用你的动物之力职业能力时，你可以选择任意的如下新形态除非它违反了你的阵营。

空气：你获得持续的羽落术效果。10级时，你改为获得持续的浮空术效果。

混乱：你的外形隐隐地改变着，使得他人难以对你进行精准的攻击。你获得25%的机率忽视重击的额外伤害以及对你攻击中的精准伤害（例如偷袭）。只有混乱角色可以使用这种位面之力。

寒冷：使用天生武器或者近战武器攻击你的角色受到寒冷伤害，你每具有2个职业等级对方就受到1d4寒冷伤害。

大地：你获得等同于你基础速度的掘地速度，并在天生护甲上获得+2环境加值。

邪恶：你的AC获得+1亵渎加值，并在对善良异界生物的攻击和能力的豁免检定上获得+1表现加值。这个加值在10级时变为+2.只有邪恶角色可以使用这个位面之力。

火焰：你的天生武器和近战武器每有4个职业等级就造成1d6火焰伤害。

善良：你的AC获得+1神圣加值，并在对邪恶异界生物的攻击和能力的豁免检定上获得+1表现加值。这个加值在10级时变为+2.只有善良角色可以使用这个位面之力。

秩序：你针对变形法术或者效果的鉴定自动成功。只有守序角色可以使用这个位面之力。

阴影：你在隐匿和巧手技能检定上获得+5加值。

水流：你获得30尺游泳速度并且可以在水下呼吸如同在空气中一样。

资源出处: Monster Summoners Handbook pg. 14

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Planar%20Focus

Planar Heritage.name: 位面血脉 Planar Heritage
Planar Heritage.description:
你的先祖能够追溯至一种本地异界生物，虽说你自身在其余方面是完完全全的人类。

先决条件：人类

书目：专长／其他专长｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Planar Hunter.name: 位面猎手 Planar Hunter
Planar Hunter.description:
在仔细研究过异界环境之后，你能够快速归纳出异界生物与其家园环境互动的方式。你透过自己对于异界生物原生环境的这份认知来调整自己的攻击，穿透异界生物天生的抗性。

先决条件：知识（位面）5级，偏好地形（任意位面）职业特性。

效果：当你位于你选为偏好地形的其中一个位面时，你对该位面原生的异界生物进行的攻击投骰获得+2加值。你对该位面原生的异界生物进行武器攻击时，可以忽略最多5点伤害减免，但不能忽略无类型的伤害减免。此外，当你遭遇跨位面生物，并辨认出它来自于你其中一个位面偏好地形（例如成功通过知识（位面）检定）时，无论你或它们位于哪个位面，你都可以获得此加值。

特殊：你可以多次选择此专长。每次选择时，将其应用于一个满足条件的不同偏好地形。

书目：平衡勇士／专长｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Planar Infusion.name: 位面谐律 Planar Infusion
Planar Infusion.description:
专长类型：Conduit

在另一个位面中度过一段艰难的岁月之后，你的身心和灵魂都被那个位面的力量所灌注。

专长效果: 你的身心或者灵魂因为你选择的满足前置条件的位面能量的灌注而获得了某种好处。位面谐律的具体描述可以在本书第三章的每个位面的谐律章节找到。需要动作启动的位面谐律能力均为超自然能力，除了那些明确地允许你释放一个法术的，在这种情况下它们是类法术能力。你从位面谐律获得的类法术能力的施法者等级等同于你的HD（至多20级）。所有其它的位面谐律能力均为特异能力。

特殊说明: 你可以多次习得这个专长。每次习得时，你必须选择一个不同的位面来获取。如果位面谐律的特殊效果完全相同，这些效果不会叠加。

资源出处: Planar Adventures pg. 31

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Planar%20Infusion

Planar Mentor.name: Planar Mentor
Planar Mentor.description:
Whether you sought it out, caught its attention, or inherited its service, an outsider is watching over you. The more you impress it, the more it shares its power and knowledge.

Benefits
When you take this feat, choose one non-unique outsider with 18 Hit Dice or fewer and whose alignment is within one step of your own along either the law/chaos axis or the good/evil axis. Twice per day (three times per day for an outsider with only neutral alignment components) when you fulfill the condition associated with either component of your mentor's alignment, you can gain your mentor's boon for that alignment as an immediate action. This grants you resistance equal to your level to a particular energy type as well as a special benefit associated with that alignment. These benefits last for a number of rounds equal to your Charisma modifier + 1 (minimum 1).

Chaotic
To earn chaotic approval, you must provoke an attack of opportunity from a creature whose CR is at least half your level. You gain acid resistance as well as a 10% miss chance due to concealment.

Evil
To earn evil approval, you must damage a flat-footed foe, hit a foe you're flanking, or confirm a critical hit. You gain fire resistance, and your attacks deal an amount of bleed damage equal to half your level.

Good
To earn good approval, you must heal another creature or deal nonlethal damage to a foe using an ability that has no additional effects beyond nonlethal damage. You gain electricity resistance and a +2 bonus on your saving throws.

Lawful
To earn lawful approval, you must perform the aid another action for an ally whose level is equal to or greater than your own, or you must benefit from the aid another action from such an ally. You gain cold resistance and the benefits of the light fortification armor special ability.

Neutral
To earn neutral approval, you must succeed at a saving throw prompted by a source with a CR of at least half your level. You gain resistance to any one energy type (your choice) and a +2 bonus on skill checks.

If your mentor is killed or imprisoned, you lose the benefits of this feat and any feats for which it is a prerequisite. When you gain a level, you can secure a new mentor by performing a ritual that takes 8 hours and expends components worth 200 gp x the new mentor's Hit Dice.

Special
At the GM's discretion, a PC can select an outsider of any alignment. This represents a relationship in which the outsider is attempting to corrupt, redeem, or otherwise influence the PC.


Pathfinder Society
When selecting an outsider of rht ePlanar Mentor feat, you must choose an outsider whose alignment is within one step of your own.

Planar Preservationist.name: 异界博物学者 Planar Preservationist
Planar Preservationist.description:
你知道如何像是保存并且复原动物一般对付那些跨位面生物。

先决条件：博物学者（Preservationist, UM炼金术师变体）变体职业。

专长效果：你每知道一个‘召唤自然盟友’配方，你学会同级的‘召唤怪物’配方。如果你以后学会了其他的‘召唤自然盟友’配方，你自动学会同级的‘召唤怪物’配方。

译者：他化自在天｜书目：专长／UM 极限魔法｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Planar Sensitivity.name: Planar Sensitivity
Planar Sensitivity.description:
You can sense and manipulate connections between the planes.

Prerequisites
Knowledge (planes) 3 ranks.

Benefits
For every summon nature's ally extract you know, you learn the equivalent summon monster spell as an extract. If you later learn other summon nature's ally extracts, you automatically learn the equivalent summon monster spell as an extract.

Special
Sentient outsiders who have one or more ranks in Knowledge (planes) and who lack the native subtype are treated as having this feat.

Gatefinder (Perception)

You can notice soulgates compatible with your alignment.

 

Check
You are familiar with soulgates and might notice those with an alignment matching your own. To notice a soulgate that you’re not already familiar with, you must succeed at a DC 20 Perception check—this DC could be higher if the portal is obscured or damaged, or at the GM’s discretion. If the soulgate shares your exact alignment, you gain a +5 bonus on your check to notice the portal, feeling an instinctual draw toward it. If your alignment and the portal’s share none of the same components, you take a –5 penalty on your check to notice the portal. If your alignment is neutral with no other alignment components, you take no penalties on checks to find soulgates.

For example, a lawful good character would gain a +5 bonus on her Perception checks to find lawful good soulgates, but would take a –5 penalty on checks to find chaotic evil, chaotic neutral, and neutral evil soulgates, as she has no chaotic, neutral, or evil components to her alignment. A neutral character, however, gains a +5 bonus on checks to find neutral gates, but gains no bonus on checks to find chaotic neutral, lawful neutral, neutral good, and neutral evil soulgates. Additionally, she takes no penalty on checks to notice chaotic good, chaotic evil, lawful good, or lawful evil soulgates.

Once you are aware of a soulgate, you never need to succeed at a Perception check to find that particular gate again, as long as some remarkable event doesn’t change its appearance or location.

Gatekeeper (Knowledge [Planes])

You can attempt to open soulgates compatible with your alignment.

 

Check
Once you are aware of a soulgate, you can use your knowledge of the planes and your place as a child of the multiverse to attempt to open the portal. This attempt takes 1 minute to perform. The DC of the Knowledge (planes) check to open a soulgate is 30. If your alignment perfectly matches that of the soulgate, you gain a +5 bonus on this check. You can also attempt to open a soulgate with an alignment that is within one step of your own. However, unless you are neutral, you cannot open a soulgate with an alignment two or more steps away from your own.

For example, a lawful evil character would gain a +5 bonus on her attempt to open a soulgate connecting the Material Plane to Hell (lawful evil) or other planes of lawful evil alignment. She can also attempt to open soulgates to Abaddon (neutral evil), Axis (lawful neutral), and other planes that share those planes’ alignments, because their alignments are one step away from lawful evil. She can never open a soulgate to the Abyss (chaotic evil), the Boneyard (neutral), Elysium (chaotic good), Heaven (lawful good), the Maelstrom (chaotic neutral), Nirvana (neutral good), or any other plane with those alignments.

If your alignment is neutral with no other alignment components, you can open soulgates with an alignment two steps away from your own, but you take a –10 penalty on attempts to do so.

Once opened, you can keep a soulgate open for a number of rounds equal to your Charisma modifier. An open soulgate closes at the end of that time, or you can close it earlier as a standard action.

Planar Survivor.name: Planar Survivor
Planar Survivor.description:
Your study of the nature and hazards of a diverse array of planes has prepared you for their dangers.

Prerequisites
Knowledge (planes) 3 ranks, Survival 3 ranks.

Benefits
You gain a +2 bonus on Survival checks on planes other than the Material Plane and a +2 bonus on saving throws against hazards encountered in such environments. If you have 10 or more ranks in Survival, the bonus on Survival checks increases to +4. This bonus does not stack with the bonus granted by the Self-Sufficient feat.

Planar Traveler.name: 位面旅者 Planar Traveler
Planar Traveler.description:
主物质位面的疆域无法满足你的漫游癖，你于不同现实宇宙之间畅通无阻。

先决条件：必须与异界生物存在血缘关系，或出生于主物质位面（Material Plane）以外的位面。

即时收益： 在故乡位面之外时，你的生存检定获得+2加值。通过成功的DC 20察觉检定，你可通过视觉或触觉识别传送门及其他位面连接点并判断其通往地点。

专长目标：在三个非故乡位面各连续停留至少24小时，或在某个非故乡位面停留超过一个月（半位面不计入此目标）。

完成收益：当你施法或使用魔法物品进行位面旅行时，必定精确抵达预期地点。此外，当你使用此专长即时收益识别传送门时，可短暂感知到传送门另一端景象、声响与气息。

推荐背景：Fey Protection,

书目：任务与战役／专长｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Planar Wanderer.name: 异界漫游者 Planar Wanderer
Planar Wanderer.description:
关于位面与传送的知识让你能够更为精确地进行位面旅行。

先决条件: 地理传送学，知识（地理）10级，知识（位面）10级，施放高等传送术（Teleport, Greater）和异界传送（Plane Shift）的能力。

专长效果: 当你研究打算使用异界传送（Plane Shift）前往的位面时，能随着施法尝试1次DC为25的知识(位面)检定。若你的检定成功，则可以在跨位面传送中前往更为准确的位置，让你抵达距离目的地5d20英里的位置，以取代原本距离目的地5d%英里的位置。如果你的结果比DC高10或更多，则会抵达距离目的地5d10英里的位置作为替代；若你的结果比DC高20或更多，则会抵达距离5d6英里的位置。

资源出处: Ultimate Intrigue pg. 88

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Planar%20Wanderer

Planar Wild Shape.name: 位面自然变身 Planar Wild Shape
Planar Wild Shape.description:
你可以向你的变身形态中注入异位面的力量。

先决条件: 【自然变身】职业特性，知识（位面）5级。

专长效果: 当你使用【自然变身】变成一种动物形态时，你可以额外花费1次自然变身的每日使用次数来给你的变身形态添加天界或炼狱模板（善良德鲁伊必须使用天界模板，而邪恶德鲁伊则只能使用炼狱模板）。如果你的形态使用了天界模板、而你用天生武器对一个邪恶生物造成了重击，你在重击确认骰上获得+2加值。反之亦然。

资源出处: Ultimate Combat pg. 113

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Planar%20Wild%20Shape

Planewalker's Insight.name: Planewalker's Insight
Planewalker's Insight.description:
You are well versed in the lore of the planes and the psychology of their natives.

Benefits
You gain a +2 bonus on Knowledge (planes) checks and on Sense Motive checks against outsiders, and Knowledge (planes) is a class skill for you. If you have 10 or more ranks in either of these skills, the bonus for that skill increases to +4. These bonuses do not stack with those granted by the Alertness or Scholar feats.

Planned Spontaneity.name: Planned Spontaneity
Planned Spontaneity.description:
You have a measure of flexibility when preparing spells.

Prerequisites
Knowledge (arcana) 9 ranks, ability to prepare and cast 4th-level spells.

Benefits
Once per day when you prepare spells, you can designate one spell slot from each of up to three different spell levels that are lower than the highest-level spell that you can cast. In each designated slot you can memorize two different spells of the respective level. You can cast either spell as normal, but when you do, the spell consumes both of the spells prepared in that spell slot.

Special
A wizard can select this feat as one of his bonus feats.

Play to the Crowd.name: 投其所好 Play to the Crowd
Play to the Crowd.description:
你能够搜集他人的利益关系，并使用这些信息来强化言语的力度。

先决条件: 智力 19，不破的逻辑，交涉5级，察言观色5级。

专长效果: 当你使用交涉来改变1名角色的态度时，可以首先尝试1次察言观色检定对抗该名NPC，以此来获得一种直觉（get a hunch），了解该名角色是否正受到附魔系效果（enchantment）的影响、对其使用查知观念*（Sense Assumptions）专长或用于在舌战（verbal duel；见本书176页）中评估偏好（biases）。若你的察言观色检定成功了，则会在交涉检定中获得+2加值，而且若你在舌战（verbal duel）中得知了任何对方的偏好（biases），则可以选择额外得知一种偏好。如果你在交涉检定中失败5点或共多的话，不会因此而让NPC的态度变差。

资源出处: Ultimate Intrigue pg. 88

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Play%20to%20the%20Crowd

Point-Blank Master.name: 贴身射击 Point-Blank Master
Point-Blank Master.description:
专长类型：Combat

你擅长使用远程武器在极近的距离攻击。

先决条件: 某种远程武器的武器专精。

专长效果: 选择一类远程武器。当你使用这类武器在敌人的威胁范围内进行射击时不会引起借机攻击。

特殊说明: 从6级起，选择【箭术战斗流派】的游侠能够将“贴身射击”作为战斗流派专长进行选取。但是他必须拥有对应武器的“武器专攻”专长来取代“武器专精”专长来满足先决条件。

通常状况: 在敌人的威胁范围内使用远程武器攻击会引起借机攻击。

资源出处: Advanced Players Guide pg. 167

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Point-Blank%20Master

战策增益：当使用任何种类的远端武器射击，投掷武器，或者做一个远端接触攻击时，你可以消耗2点耐力来避免一次借机攻击。

战策资源出处: Pathfinder Unchained pg. 129

Point-Blank Shot (Mythic).name: 近距射击(神话) Point-Blank Shot (Mythic)
Point-Blank Shot (Mythic).description:
先决条件：近距射击

只要距离够近，你的远程攻击就会无比精确。

神话专长效果：近距射击专长对攻击与伤害检定的加值提升至2点。以迅捷动作，你能够花费1次神话之力，使这些检定获得等同于你的阶层的一半的额外加值。

资源出处: Mythic Adventures pg. 71

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Point-Blank%20Shot

Poised Bearing.name: 蓄势姿态 Poised Bearing
Poised Bearing.description:
专长类型：Armor MasteryCombat

你盔甲的重量让你拥有了稳定的下盘。

先决条件: 基本攻击加值+6或者战士4级，盔甲训练职业特性，擅长中甲或重甲。

专长效果: 在决定冲撞，拖拽，闯越或者摔绊战技所能对抗的生物体型时，你的体型视为比原来大一级。

资源出处: Armor Masters Handbook pg. 17

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Poised%20Bearing

战策增益：你可以一个迅捷动作消耗3点耐力，这个专长对你体型的效果将会决定其他生物能否对你施展特定战技。

战策资源出处: Armor Master's Handbook pg. 21

Poison Focus.name: 毒素专攻 Poison Focus
Poison Focus.description:
你知道创造特别恶毒的毒药的秘密。

先决条件：工艺（炼金术）1级。

专长效果：使用工艺（炼金术）制造的任何毒药的以及使用毒物描述符（Pathfinder RPG Ultimate Magic 138）施放的任何法术的豁免DC都会增加1。 此奖励不会与法术专攻授予的奖励叠加。

书目：炼金术手册AM／专长｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Poison Resin.name: Poison Resin
Poison Resin.description:
The toxic slime from your skin hardens into a thick, venomous resin that you can craft into various shapes.

Prerequisites
Grippli, toxic skin alternate racial trait.

Benefits
As a standard action, you can spend a use of your toxic skin alternate racial trait to create any simple light weapon out of your hardened secretions. This weapon remains intact and usable for 1 hour. Once per minute when making an attack, you can treat this weapon as if you had applied your grippli racial poison to it. You can use this envenoming function a number of times per day equal to your Constitution modifier for any individual weapon created. Anyone other than you who attempts to wield the weapon is exposed to your poison.

Poison Shot Deed.name: 药铳 Poison Shot Deed
Poison Shot Deed.description:
你手中的枪支犹如毒龙喷烟，所当者皆糜烂。

先决条件：业余枪手UC专长或勇毅（Grit）UC职业能力

专长效果：通过消耗1点勇毅值，你可以以一个移动动作在枪管铳填入一剂吸入（Inhaled）或摄入（Ingested）型毒药，你不会因为这样做而失误使自己中毒（如同你拥有用毒职业能力一般）。然后，如果你以一个可引发借机攻击的标准动作把这发毒弹发射出去，它可以影响15尺锥形范围的所有敌人。这些敌人不承受伤害，但是会立刻暴露在毒素之中并必须进行一次豁免检定（如同毒素的潜伏期已经过去）否则中毒。

译者：傻豆｜书目：专长／阴招战术工具箱｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Poisoner's Channel.name: 投毒引导 Poisoner's Channel
Poisoner's Channel.description:
先决条件：引导负能量3d6，信仰诺格巴

先决条件: 引导负能量3d6，信仰诺格巴。

专长效果: 每天一次，当你引导负能量伤害活物时，你可以使任何在对抗引导能量的豁免检定失败的生物在对抗毒素的豁免检定上承受-4减值。这一减值持续一分钟。

资源出处: Inner Sea Gods pg. 215

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Poisoner's%20Channel

Polyglot Familiar.name: Polyglot Familiar
Polyglot Familiar.description:
Your familiar can speak with animals other than those of its own kind.

Prerequisites
Must have a familiar.

Benefits
Choose a category of creature: amphibians, birds, felines, invertebrates, reptiles, rodents, simians, or vermin. Your familiar can speak with creatures of that kind.

Special
This feat can be taken multiple times, choosing a different category of creature each time. The first time you take this feat, if your familiar can't already speak with creatures of its kind, you must choose that category of creature. If your familiar later gains the ability to speak with creatures of its kind, you can choose to apply this feat's benefits to a different category of creature instead.

Polytheistic Blessing.name: Polytheistic Blessing
Polytheistic Blessing.description:
You are granted a small bit of divine power as a result of your veneration of a pantheon of deities.

Prerequisites
Wis 13, must worship a pantheon.

Benefits
When you take this feat, select a pantheon from the list below. You gain the listed spell-like ability for your selected pantheon, usable once per day. If the granted spell allows a saving throw, the DC is equal to 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Charisma modifier.

Special
If you act out of line with the tenets of your pantheon's beliefs, you lose the ability to cast the granted spell-like ability until you have received an atonement for your transgression (as a cleric attempting to regain lost class abilities).

Juju Pantheon (Cultural)

Deities wendo (supernatural entities of the spirit world; see Faiths & Philosophies 14)

Common Believers juju practitioners, wendifa

Granted Spell-like Ability speak with animals

Sar-Gorog Pantheon (Aligned and Cultural)

Deities Urgathoa (NE), Rovagug (CE), and Zura (CE)

Common Believers Koboto cannibal tribes of the Sodden Lands

Granted Spell-like Ability decompose corpseUM; if you use this ability on a corpse rather than on a corporeal undead, you receive nourishment as though you had eaten a normal meal for a Medium creature.

Note
This feat first appeared in Pathfinder Player Companion: Faiths & Philosophies as Pantheistic Blessing, but is corrected and expanded here to include a benefit for juju practitioners and worshipers of Sar-Gorog.

Pommel Strike Deed.name: 刀柄打 Pommel Strike Deed
Pommel Strike Deed.description:
专长类型：Panache

在拔刀的一合，你的刀柄已经捅进对手的身体，将他击倒在地。

先决条件: 业余剑客或派头职业能力；基础攻击加值+3。

专长效果: 你可以消耗1点时髦值，以一个标准动作使用一件轻型或单手穿刺武器的手柄打击敌人。你的这次攻击视为你使用武器正常发动攻击（使用受到游荡剑客的所有职业能力，专长和其他效果的加成），不过这次攻击的伤害为1d6（小体型剑客1d4）点钝击伤害，重击范围20/x2，并且不会因为精通重击，锐锋武器附魔等效果而增加重击范围。如果攻击命中，你可以一自由动作进行一次战技攻击检定，如果成功，对方将被击倒至俯卧状态。

资源出处: Advanced Class Guide pg. 153

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Pommel%20Strike%20Deed

Poppet Familiar.name: 人偶魔宠 Poppet Familiar
Poppet Familiar.description:
出自：Adventurer's Armory 2 pg. 31

你可以选择一个人偶作为你的魔宠。

先决条件：有能力获得新魔宠，施法者等级3级。

译者：萌新也有滥强的心｜书目：冒险者的军械库2／制造人偶｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Porcupine Defense.name: Porcupine Defense
Porcupine Defense.description:
You are a threat to opponents that try to overwhelm you.

Prerequisites
Combat Expertise, Combat Reflexes, base attack bonus +6.

Benefits
Whenever an opponent of at least one size category larger than yourself attempts a combat maneuver attack against you, you gain a +2 bonus on any allowed attacks of opportunity. If your opponent may make such attacks without provoking attacks of opportunity, you instead gain a +2 bonus to CMD against such maneuvers.

Combat Trick
You can spend 5 stamina points to make an attack of opportunity against an opponent at least one size category larger than you if that opponent attempts a combat maneuver check against you. You can perform this attack of opportunity even if your opponent can attempt such combat maneuvers without normally provoking attacks of opportunity. (Dragonslayer's Handbook 25)

Position of Strength.name: Position of Strength
Position of Strength.description:
You know how to press your advantage when negotiating with noncombatants.

Prerequisites
Intimidate 5 ranks.

Benefits
As long as you are wielding one or more weapons with which you are proficient, you gain a +4 bonus on Intimidate checks against unarmed creatures, which doesn't stack with Intimidating Prowess. Additionally, if you successfully use Intimidate to demoralize an unarmed creature, that creature becomes shaken for as long as you continue to be armed and they continue not to be, to a maximum of 1 minute. Creatures with natural attacks, or whose unarmed strikes deal lethal damage, are considered to be armed for the purposes of this feat.

Possessed Hand.name: 鬼上手 Possessed Hand
Possessed Hand.description:
你跟幽灵、精魄、或异界生物达成了和平永久的交易。它附身在你的手中，引导和协助你作为回报获得帮助。

专长效果：你吸引有个人动机的幽灵、精魄、或异界生物去附身你的手。此通常通常涉及某种互惠契约或协议。你的鬼手能在多方面协助你，但它的周期性不受控制的夸张举止使你分心；你一旦获得此专长后在专注检定永远承受-2罚值。

任何你用鬼手以单手武器、轻型武器、徒手击打、或天生攻击作出的攻击在攻击骰和伤害骰获得+1洞察加值。你还在解除装置和巧手检定获得+1洞察加值。每天1次以迅捷动作，你能取出您携带的任何存放物品，只要该物品不重于5磅以上。

译者：犬良人｜书目：闹鬼英雄手册HHH／专长｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Potent Holy Symbol.name: Potent Holy Symbol
Potent Holy Symbol.description:
In your pious hands, your holy symbol is a shining light of faith.

Prerequisites
Good alignment, worshiper of a good deity.

Benefits
Any round in which you use your holy symbol as a divine focus for the casting of a spell or to channel positive energy, you count as presenting a holy symbol, chanting prayers, or ringing a hand bell for the purpose of keeping vampires at bay.

Potion Glutton.name: 狂喝滥饮 Potion Glutton
Potion Glutton.description:
你灌下药水的速度快到吓人

先决条件：信仰厄迦图娅

效果：当你喝下药水或药剂时，你只需要一个移动动作且不会导致借机攻击。

正常情况：喝下药水是一个标准动作，且会导致借机攻击

防护引导

译者：傻豆｜书目：专长／内海诸神｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Power Attack (Mythic).name: 猛力攻击(神话) Power Attack (Mythic)
Power Attack (Mythic).description:
先决条件：猛力攻击

你的攻击极具毁灭性。

神话专长效果：当你使用猛力攻击时，你的近战伤害检定获得+3加值，而非原本的+2点。当你的基本攻击加值达到+4以及之后每提高4点时，伤害加值的数值都会+3点以取代原本的+2点。此外，来自该专长的伤害加值会在重击时翻倍，而且这是在应用武器重击倍率之前进行的。

当你启动猛力攻击时，能够花费1次神话之力，以此在1分钟内忽略该专长对近战攻击检定与战技检定带来的惩罚。

资源出处: Mythic Adventures pg. 71

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Power%20Attack

Powerful Poisoning.name: 迅猛之毒 Powerful Poisoning
Powerful Poisoning.description:
依靠蛮力，你将武器上涂抹的毒药深深打进敌人的身体。

先决条件：猛力攻击，手艺（制毒）技能3级或用毒（Poison Use）职业能力

专长效果：当你使用一件施加过毒药的武器并发动猛力攻击专长对一个对手造成伤害时，你可以放弃猛力攻击提供的伤害加值，而选择将武器附带毒素的DC+1。当你的基础攻击加值增加到+4以及之后每再提升+4时，这个DC加值也随之增加1点。但是，本专长的效果不会让毒药的DC增加到超过15+你的角色等级的一半。

译者：傻豆｜书目：专长／阴招战术工具箱｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Powerful Shape.name: 壮硕形体 Powerful Shape
Powerful Shape.description:
你的自然变身是如此的威武霸气！

先决条件：【自然变身】职业特性，德鲁伊8级。

专长效果：自然变身状态中，在计算CMB、CMD、承载能力、或者任何与体型相关的特殊攻击（如攫抓、吞咽、践踏）时，将你的体型视为大一级。

译者：他化自在天｜书目：专长／UM 极限魔法｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Powerful Shape (Mythic).name: 壮硕形体(神话) Powerful Shape (Mythic)
Powerful Shape (Mythic).description:
先决条件：壮硕形体

你在自然变身中化身的形态远超自然界中的同类。

神话专长效果：你能够将巨化生物模板（快速套用规则版，请见怪物图鉴的295页）套用到任何自然变身变化的形态上。这会取代壮硕形体专长的好处。

以自由动作，你能够花费1次神话之力，以此将该专长与非神话版的壮硕形体专长的好处结合起来，持续轮数等同于你的阶层。

资源出处: Mythic Adventures pg. 71

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Powerful%20Shape

Powerful Tongue.name: 强力舌头 Powerful Tongue
Powerful Tongue.description:
和你的大多数同类不同，你的舌头强健到可以将被粘住的猎物拖近你的位置。

先决条件: 力量17，粘性舌头特殊攻击。

专长效果: 你的舌击攻击可以进行拖拽（Pull）特殊攻击。在你的回合开始时，只要你的舌头粘住一个体型不大于你的生物，你就可以通过一次成功的战技攻击检定，以一个自由动作将它拉近你5尺。

资源出处: Monster Codex pg. 8

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Powerful%20Tongue

Powerful Wings.name: Powerful Wings
Powerful Wings.description:
You have a large wingspan for a member of your race, and can use these appendages to batter your foes.

Prerequisites
Str 13, Skill Focus (Fly), base attack bonus +8.

Benefits
You gain two wing attacks. These are secondary natural attacks that each deal damage appropriate to a creature one size category larger than yourself (see page 302 of the Bestiary). You are also considered one size category larger for the purposes of any feats or abilities related to your wings, such as the Hover feat.

Special
While the following feats are primarily taken by strix, other creatures with natural wings can also take them at the GM's discretion.

Practical Kata.name: 实用形 Practical Kata
Practical Kata.description:
你的武学冥想延伸至战场上

先决条件：精通徒手打击，气池职业特性

专长效果：当你用近战攻击命中你本轮已经造成伤害的对手时，你可以放弃造成伤害，而是恢复1点气。该专长每分钟只能恢复1点气。你每拥有4个职业等级，每天最多可恢复 1点气。

译者：肥鱼｜书目：武术手册Martial Arts Handbook／融会专长｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Practiced Dreamer.name: Practiced Dreamer
Practiced Dreamer.description:
Your time in the Dimension of Dreams has improved your ability to manipulate its landscape.

Prerequisites
Cha 15, Lucid Dreamer, Knowledge (planes) 5 ranks.

Benefits
Once per day, you can reroll a failed attempt to perform an impossible action, such as casting a spell you can't normally cast, gaining an effect of a spell as if it had been cast, or conjuring a magic item. You also gain an additional +2 bonus on Charisma checks to determine your initial condition when entering a dream with your lucid body.

Practiced Leadership.name: 熟练领导者 Practiced Leadership
Practiced Leadership.description:
当你和你的部属都是同一个组织的成员时，你就不必独自承担领导的重任。通过依赖于你们共同组织的权威以及你们自己的领导技能，你们的团队表现出了更好的奉献精神和战术敏锐性。

先决条件:领导力，与你的部属在同一组织中的成员资格。

好处:只要你和你的部属在同一个组织中保持良好的成员关系，你的同伴在对抗惑控系法术和效果的意志豁免上获得+4士气加值。此外，为了确定你是否能从团队专长中获得加值，你的同事会被视为拥有与你相同的团队专长。你的队友不会从这些专长中获得任何奖励，除非她真的拥有这些专长。

如果您和您的部属属于本节中列出的组织之一，您的部属将获得与您的组织相关的熟练领导者优势。如果你的部属获得了类法术能力，施法者等级是1或者等于你的部属施法者等级，两者以较高的为准。

书目：平衡勇士／专长｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Practiced Ritualist.name: 熟练祭祀 Practiced Ritualist
Practiced Ritualist.description:
在仪式施法者当中，你是个经验丰富的领头人。

先决条件：知识技能（奥秘，历史，位面和宗教）1级

专长效果：你在进行异能仪式（occult rituals，异能冒险OA208页）的技能检定，以及学习施放异能仪式的知识检定上获得+2加值。如果你是该仪式的主施法者（a ritual’s primary caster）,对抗仪式效果的豁免DC+2.如果该仪式有所需副施法者的最小数量（minimum number of required secondary casters），该数量-1.

书目：魔法战术工具箱／专长｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Practiced Tactician.name: 战术熟练 Practiced Tactician
Practiced Tactician.description:
通过简单的手势与指令，你能够在战斗中指挥他人。

先决条件：【战术】职业特性。

专长效果：每日你可以额外获得1次机会使用【战术】职业特性赋予同伴团队专长。

特殊说明：你可以多次选取本专长，它的效果叠加。

译者：佐鸟カナコ，四月｜书目：专长／APG 进阶玩家手册｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Precipice Strike.name: Precipice Strike
Precipice Strike.description:
Rough mountain roads are as smooth as cobblestone to you. Enemies challenge you in your home territory at their peril.

Prerequisites
Dex 15, base attack bonus +6, cragkin half-orc.

Benefits
When you and the target of your attack are both in difficult terrain, treat the target as if he were flat-footed. In addition, if you attack a flat-footed enemy from a higher elevation (including while falling), you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on your attack roll.

Precocious Youth.name: 早熟少年 Precocious Youth
Precocious Youth.description:
即便年少，你已展现出超越同龄人的成熟特质，这份早慧无疑将在未来岁月中助你前行。

先决条件：少年年龄阶段。

专长效果：你可移除少年年龄阶段的-2体质、-2力量或-2感知的任一项属性罚值。当你进入成年阶段时，可将此专长替换为强韧加强（Great Fortitude）、钢铁意志（Iron Will)或

书目：任务与战役／专长｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Preferred Spell.name: 偏好法术 Preferred Spell
Preferred Spell.description:
你发现自己很容易施放某个特定的法术。

先决条件：法术辨识5级，法术升阶。

专长效果：选择一个你能够施放的法术。你能够通过牺牲一个与其环级相同或者更高环级的准备好的法术或法术位来自发施展它。你能够在施放它的时候应用你所拥有的任何超魔专长，为了这么做你需要提高需要牺牲的法术的最低等级，不过这不会增加法术的施放时间。

特殊说明：你能够多次选取该专长。它的效果不会叠加。每次选取该专长，它都会应用在不同的法术上。

译者：佐鸟カナコ，四月｜书目：专长／APG 进阶玩家手册｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Press to the Wall.name: 墙角战法 Press to the Wall
Press to the Wall.description:
当你的目标没法轻易逃离时，你更加牛逼。

先决条件：快步跟进，BAB+3

专长效果：若你是唯一一个威胁目标的单位，你可以在决定是否夹击目标时，将邻接目标的占据一个格子的固态不可移动物体（例如柱子、树干、墙）视为正威胁目标。

译者：月夜白雨｜书目：专长／近战战术工具箱｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Pressure Adept.name: Pressure Adept
Pressure Adept.description:
You've spent so much time at unusual pressures that you've extended your native range beyond the norms of your species.

Prerequisites
Swim 5 ranks.

Benefits
Add one oceanic zone to your native range when calculating pressure (meaning that you don't take pressure damage in that range unless instantaneously transported up or down, and even then you adapt to the change all at once rather than 100 feet at a time). Surfacedwellers taking this feat must select the sunlight zone, and aquatic creatures can select any zone either directly above or directly below their native range.

Prestigious Spellcaster.name: Prestigious Spellcaster
Prestigious Spellcaster.description:
The transition into a spellcasting prestige class is less difficult for you, and because of this, you gain 1 additional effective spellcaster level from your prestige class levels.

Prerequisites
Favored Prestige Class with selected prestige class.

Benefits
The first time you gain a level in your favored prestige class and the spells per day class feature does not grant an increase in effective level for the purpose of casting spells, you gain new spells per day as if the prestige class did grant +1 level of spellcasting for that level. This effect is retroactive if you gain this feat at a level beyond the point where your favored prestige class would normally have not advanced your spellcasting.

The Prestigious Spellcaster feat does not have any effect if your favored prestige class does not have the spells per day class feature, or if it does have the spells per day class feature but already grants a level increase for every level of the prestige class (as do the arcane trickster and loremaster prestige classes).

Normal
You can select the Prestigious Spellcaster feat multiple times. Each time you select the Prestigious Spellcaster feat, your effective caster level increases by 1. However, regardless of the number of times you choose this feat, the total increase to your effective caster level cannot exceed your actual prestige class level.
This feat also applies to prestige classes that grant extracts per day instead of spells per day.

Primal Ancestry.name: Primal Ancestry
Primal Ancestry.description:
You have a deep connection to the primal First World and can channel this link into powerful effects once a day.

Prerequisites
Wis 13, member of the Primordial Ones

Benefits
Once per day as a move action, you can tap into the essence of the First World, and gain DR 5/cold iron for 1 minute. If you have 11 or more Hit Dice, this increases to DR 10/cold iron. Additionally, while under this effect, enchantment spells you cast gain a +1 bonus to caster level.

Primal Bloom.name: 原初绽放 Primal Bloom
Primal Bloom.description:
只需一个呼声，你就能唤来第一世界里奇幻莫测的魔法力量。

先决条件：知识（位面）10级

效果：以一个标准动作，你可以制造一个以你为中心扩散的半径50尺受到原初奇异力量的影响的区域。该区域可持续1分钟，且区域制造后固定不变直到时间结束。受影响区域获得狂野魔法位面特性（见第63页），且受影响区域内的施法者正常运作法术的施法者等级检定DC增加5。如果该区域此前已经有狂野魔法位面特性，那么该区域内施法者正常运作法术的施法者等级检定DC改为增加10。

你每天能使用本专长一次，当你在知识（位面）上有15或更多个等级时，每天可使用本专长两次，而当你拥有20个知识等级时，每天可使用本专长三次。

书目：专长／汲引专长｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Primal Kineticist.name: Primal Kineticist
Primal Kineticist.description:
When primal magic surrounds you, you can channel it to transform the nature of your kinetic blasts.

Prerequisites
Kineticist level 1st.

Benefits
When using a simple kinetic blast in an area where primal magic is either predominant or very common, you can accept 1 point of burn to cause your blast to become one of the following simple blasts instead. Roll 1d10 to determine the simple blast: 1 = air, 2 = cold, 3 = earth, 4 = electric, 5 = fire, 6 = gravity, 7 = negative, 8 = telekinetic, 9 = water, 10 = wood. You can apply any of your form or substance infusions that are allowed as choices for the random blast, accepting the typical burn cost.

Primal Strike.name: Primal Strike
Primal Strike.description:
You have learned to draw primal magic through your body to befuddle your enemies.

Prerequisites
Wis 17, Improved Unarmed Strike, base attack bonus +8.

Benefits
Before making an attack roll, you can declare a primal strike. If you do and the attack hits, it deals damage normally and your target must attempt a Fortitude saving throw (DC = 10 + half your character level + your Wisdom modifier). A target who fails this saving throw is confused for 1 round. If you are in an area of primal magic, the confused condition lasts for 1d4 rounds. You can attempt a primal strike attack once per day for every 4 character levels you have (see Special below if you have monk levels), but no more than once per round. A primal strike is a mind-affecting compulsion effect.

Special
If you have levels in the monk class, you can make a primal attack a number of times per day equal to your monk level, plus one additional time per day for every 4 levels you have in classes other than monk, though still no more than once per round.

Prodigy.name: 奇才 Prodigy
Prodigy.description:
你天生就擅长于艺术和手艺。

专长效果：从工艺、表演或者专业技能中任选两种（例如两种工艺，或者一种工艺一种表演）。你在这些技能的检定上获得+2加值。如果你在这些技能上拥有10个或者更高的受训等级，加值将会提升到+4。

特殊说明：你可以多次选择本专长，其效果不累计。每次你选择本专长，它适用于两个新技能。

译者：他化自在天｜书目：专长／UM 极限魔法｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Profane Studies.name: Profane Studies
Profane Studies.description:
Your study of fiends grants you advantages when summoning or fighting them.

Prerequisites
Int 13, Knowledge (planes) 4 ranks, ability to cast a summon monster spell.

Benefits
You gain a +5 bonus on Knowledge (planes) checks involving evil outsiders. Additionally, when you cast a summon monster spell to summon an evil outsider, treat your caster level as 2 levels higher for the purpose of determining the duration.

Prone Shooter.name: 匍匐射手 Prone Shooter
Prone Shooter.description:
专长类型：Combat

当你俯卧时，你可以将弩或火器撑在地上稳定的射击。

先决条件: 基本攻击加值+1。

专长效果: 如果你在你上一次行动结束时处于俯卧状态，你在对抗近战攻击的防御等级的减值降到-2。此外，你在对抗远程攻击的防御等级的加值上升到+6。 。

资源出处: Ultimate Combat pg. 113

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Prone%20Shooter

战策增益：只要你的耐力池中还有1点耐力，你就能获得这个专长的加值，即使你在你上一回合结束的时候并未俯卧。

战策资源出处: Pathfinder Unchained pg. 129

Prone Slinger.name: 匍匐投手 Prone Slinger
Prone Slinger.description:
专长类型：Combat

你即使在俯卧状态也能熟练的侧身发射弹药和石头。

专长效果: 在俯卧时，你可以使用投石索进行远程攻击。

通常状况: 只有弩和火器可以在俯卧状态进行远程攻击。

资源出处: Ultimate Combat pg. 113

原文索引: https://www.aonprd.com/FeatDisplay.aspx?ItemName=Prone%20Slinger

战策增益：只要你的耐力池中还有1点耐力，你就能在俯卧并使用投石索攻击时在攻击骰上获得+2加值。

战策资源出处: Pathfinder Unchained pg. 129

Prophet.name: 布道先知 Prophet
Prophet.description:
真相已然显露，而你则被选定令其实现。

先决条件：你必须能够施放神术、并且从你所信奉的神祇（或其他合适的超自然存在）处获得一项神谕；或你拥有“神赋刻印（Marked by the Gods）”角色背景。

即时收益：若你非邪恶且侍奉非邪恶神祇，当你为同伴施放有益法术时，你获得神圣AC+1，持续每法术等级1轮。若你邪恶或侍奉邪恶神祇，当你向敌人施放有害法术时，你获得亵渎AC+1，持续每法术等级1轮。对自己施法则无此效果，除非该法术同时也影响同伴。

专长目标：使适当数量的生物皈依到你所信奉的神祇座下。

完成收益：你对他人施放有益或有害法术后获得的AC加值增至+2，并且这些加值在效果时间内还能应用于豁免。

译者：傻豆｜书目：专长／UCa 极限战役｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Prophetic Visionary.name: 未来福音 Prophetic Visionary
Prophetic Visionary.description:
你的先知能力使你得以一瞥未来。

先决条件：【秘示域】职业特性。

专长效果：每天1次，你能够进入一种入神状态并且一观未来的景象。入神持续10分钟，在这段时间里你不能进行任何其他的行动。如果你被打断了，你必须重新开始。当你入神结束后，你可以得知接下来的某个特定行为带来的结果是好是坏，这如同一个‘占卜术’般有70%的成功率。

译者：他化自在天｜书目：专长／UM 极限魔法｜CHM 出处：果园原帖（CHM v2.31.0）｜AoN 出处：Archives of Nethys

Prophetic Visionary (Mythic).name: 未来福音(神话) Prophetic Visionary (Mythic)
Prophetic Visionary (Mythic).description:
先决条件：未来福音

你的预知能力能够进一步帮助你。
